title: Head of Paid Acquisition
description:
**About Click&Boat**
--------------------

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy.

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals, with over €170M in annual GMV and a community of 2.4M+ registered users across 150+ countries worldwide. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the globe, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To fuel our next phase of growth, we're hiring a Head of Paid Acquisition to own and scale our paid marketing strategy, based in our Barcelona office.

**The role**
------------

We're looking for a Head of Paid Acquisition to join our crew in Barcelona and own the strategy behind how we acquire renters and boat owners at scale, across all our markets.

Paid acquisition is a core growth lever for Click&Boat, sitting at the intersection of performance marketing, data, and brand. You'll lead a team of 3, own the paid media P&L, and work in close, day-to-day collaboration with Global Group Head of Performance (based in Miami) to align on global strategy, share learnings across the Group's marketplaces, and make the most of our combined scale.

Given the strategic weight of paid acquisition in our growth model, you'll report and present regularly to our Executive Board as well as to Boats Group stakeholders, on performance, strategy, and investment decisions.

**What floats your boat**
-------------------------

* Define and own the paid acquisition strategy (SEA, paid social, display/programmatic, app campaigns) across all markets, to hit revenue, contribution margin, and growth targets.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 3 Paid Acquisition Managers, setting clear objectives and building a culture of accountability, testing, and continuous improvement.
* Own the paid media budget and P&L: allocate spend by market and channel, and manage CAC/ROAS targets with rigor.
* Partner closely with Global Group Head of Performance to align on global media strategy, share best practices across the Group's marketplaces, and coordinate shared vendor relationships (Google, Meta, TikTok, etc.) where relevant.
* Report to the Executive Board and Boats Group stakeholders on performance and strategy, translating data into clear investment recommendations.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Tech, and Data teams on tracking, attribution, and landing page optimisation.
* Identify and test new channels and formats, and assess where AI can improve targeting, bidding, or creative performance.

**What you bring aboard**
-------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in paid acquisition / performance marketing, ideally in a B2C, marketplace, e-commerce, or travel environment.
* 3+ years of experience managing a team, driving performance through coaching, prioritisation, and clear goal-setting.
* Deep hands-on expertise across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and programmatic/display, ideally in multi-market, multi-language contexts.
* Data-obsessed and analytically rigorous: comfortable building and reading dashboards (Tableau or equivalent) and modeling CAC/LTV/ROAS.
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed, international organisation, collaborating with Group stakeholders across time zones.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and confidently to a Board / C-level audience.
* Full proficiency in English is required.

###### **Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Fluent in Spanish or French.
* Experience in the travel or marketplace industry.
* Experience working within a global group structure, balancing local execution with global alignment.

**The hiring journey**
----------------------

* HR call with our Head of Talent Acquisition
* Manager interview with our Head of Paid Acquisition (Group)
* Interview with our CTO
* Culture fit interview (VP People) / Validation interview (CEO)

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

**What awaits you aboard**
--------------------------

* Real strategic scope: you own paid acquisition end-to-end, with visibility all the way to the Board.
* Exposure to a global Group: close, regular collaboration with Boats Group's team in Miami.
* 23 days of paid leave.
* 10 extra days off (CAB days).
* Restaurant tickets: €3.50 per worked day, 100% paid by CAB.
* Flexible retribution.
* Wellhub (sport & wellbeing discounts).
* Hybrid working arrangement: office Monday to Thursday, remote on Fridays.
* Boat licence
* Boat hire vouchers for friends & family, no commission when you're on board, 50% commission for your immediate family.
* Free bike parking, and discounted car parking with OCW.

Contract: Full-time, permanent.

Team: 3 direct reports.

**Ready to come aboard?**
-------------------------

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit "apply to this job". At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, strictly based on merit and regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We are committed to an inclusive process and will provide reasonable accommodations upon request during both selection and employment—because we hire for talent, drive, and mindset, and the sea is open to all.

title: Faculty Member - CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming
description:
**Seville Faculty Member: CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming**

On-site - Seville | Verto Education  
Learn more about us:  
https://vertoeducation.org/abroad-locations/study-abroad-spain/

**About Verto**

Verto is on a mission to provide the best possible start to college. We make travel and experiential education a core part of the first year, enabling students to begin their academic journey overseas before transferring to one of 70+ partner universities in the United States.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
* Accurately calculate and submit grades on-time through the LMS and via the Academic Provider’s grade reporting software (Banner), following established mid-term and end-of-term grade reporting timelines and protocols. Respond to student inquiries related to their grades in a timely manner including any grade disputes or discrepancies after the final grading period.
* Foster learning environments that are respectful and positive, conducive to early college student development, adhere to Verto values, and that are characterized by learner-centered approaches to instructional design and delivery:
  + Helping students develop their academic identity and foundational academic skills with appropriate levels of challenge and support
  + Appropriate use of professional language and tone, modeling constructive feedback and conflict negotiation
  + Active classroom management and consideration of power dynamics in faculty-student relationships
  + Auditing course materials for representation for diverse student populations by including bringing in local and global perspectives through course readings, assignments, and activities.
* Build and maintain positive, collaborative, and professional relationships with program participants, staff, and community partners.
* Share feedback with local and global Verto academic leaders to provide recommendations for academic excellence and faculty support needs.
* Participate in curriculum development projects and assessment initiatives as directed by the University of New Haven and Verto Edcuation.
* Other duties as reasonably assigned.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. Faculty are an integral part of helping new college students build appropriate academic skills and will integrate academic skill building into courses and help identify growth opportunities for learners.

Candidates must be dynamic educators who are motivated by working with a first-year student population and building professional relationships with students and peers to support student engagement and academic success. Faculty will participate in academic and professional development training prior to, and throughout, the semester to support teaching and learning. Faculty are required to utilize the established academic policies and daily reporting tools for attendance, as described. All faculty will develop and lead active and experiential learning activities as part of the curriculum.

* Faculty who are intellectually curious and motivated, and are skilled in teaching concepts in various settings (e.g., in or outside of the classroom).
* Faculty who demonstrate genuine care about students and ability to connect and engage students in learning.
* Faculty who are willing to go that extra mile to support students' success in their start to their new college career.
* Faculty who excel at and love teaching, and are also willing to learn from their students and colleagues.
* Faculty who are versatile and flexible to meet dynamic and changing environments.
* Faculty who demonstrate high levels of professionalism and commitment and are open to continuous learning and development.
* Verto seeks faculty who can be a bridge to the local culture and help bring learning to life for students above all else.
  

**Application Instructions**

To apply, please submit the following:

* Cover Letter - a letter of interest (no more than 2 pages) that articulates your experience and qualifications in relation to the job description. Please share your specific experience with US higher education and higher education systems in the country where you are applying to teach, and share examples of active and experiential learning and how you support diverse learners' needs.

* Current Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* References - Names and contact information of three references who will provide a professional recommendation.
* Unofficial transcripts of graduate work. If your graduate degree was conferred from an institution that doesn’t traditionally issue transcripts, please upload a scanned copy of your diploma.
* Teaching evaluations from related courses / up to three separate semesters, if available.

Faculty will be asked to share a schedule of availability and complete a background check as part of the hiring process. All faculty are subject to final review and approval by the University of New Haven.
  
  
**Enrollment Sizes & Course Details**

Course assignments are typically 45 hours (3 U.S. credits) or 60 hours (4 U.S. credit) courses, depending on the course and discipline (4 credit/60 hours are typical for Lab or Studio based courses).

Faculty may be invited to teach multiple sections of the same course, when possible, and/or multiple courses directly related to their academic field of expertise, if related courses are available.

Course syllabi are developed and approved by the Academic Provider, along with specific information regarding course learning outcomes, academic policies, assessment of learning, and overall expectations. Faculty typically develop their own teaching materials, including schedule, readings, assignments, experiential learning activities, and develop and manage a course site via the Learning Management System, Canvas. Some courses are delivered in a sequential manner (e.g. BIOL I & II) or offered across all locations (e.g. ENGL 1112) and may have required course textbooks, common assignments or assessments, or other materials that are standard for course delivery.

Section enrollment varies by program location, scheduling, student enrollment, and classroom size. Specific information will be provided by the local program staff.

* Language courses: Approximately 15-18 students
* Non-language courses: Approximately 15-24 students
Lab courses: Typically fewer than 25 students  

**Why Join Verto?**  
***The below are for full-time Employees in the United States (benefits for international staff benefits vary by location and meet or exceed local standards)***

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation reimagining higher education
* ✈️ Work in a globally-minded, international environment
* Exposure to cross-functional teams (academics, operations, student life)
* Opportunity to grow in a fast-moving, impact-driven organisation

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**Compensation**  
At Verto, base salary is one part of your total compensation package.

Final base pay will depend on your location (aligned to Verto’s compensation regions), as well as your experience, skills, and relevant qualifications. Your recruiter/hiring manager can share the specific range for your location during the hiring process.

**On-site - Seville** **— Anticipated Base Salary Range**  
€900–€1,200 per credit.  
  

* **️ Right to Work**

You must have the legal right to work in Spain. Verto Education is unable to sponsor visas for this role.  
  

* **Accessibility & Accommodations**

Verto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities. If you require support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

  

**Data Privacy**

By applying for this role, you acknowledge that Verto Education will process your personal data for recruitment purposes. This includes assessing your application, communicating with you, and managing the hiring process. Verto is on a mission to provide the best possible start to college. We make travel and experiential education a core part of the first year, enabling students to begin their academic journey overseas before transferring to one of 70+ partner universities in the United States.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. * Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. Faculty are an integral part of helping new college students build appropriate academic skills and will integrate academic skill building into courses and help identify growth opportunities for learners.

Candidates must be dynamic educators who are motivated by working with a first-year student population and building professional relationships with students and peers to support student engagement and academic success. Faculty will participate in academic and professional development training prior to, and throughout, the semester to support teaching and learning. Faculty are required to utilize the established academic policies and daily reporting tools for attendance, as described. All faculty will develop and lead active and experiential learning activities as part of the curriculum.

* Faculty who are intellectually curious and motivated, and are skilled in teaching concepts in various settings (e.g., in or outside of the classroom).
* Faculty who demonstrate genuine care about students and ability to connect and engage students in learning.
* Faculty who are willing to go that extra mile to support students' success in their start to their new college career.
* Faculty who excel at and love teaching, and are also willing to learn from their students and colleagues.
* Faculty who are versatile and flexible to meet dynamic and changing environments.
* Faculty who demonstrate high levels of professionalism and commitment and are open to continuous learning and development.

Please share your specific experience with US higher education and higher education systems in the country where you are applying to teach, and share examples of active and experiential learning and how you support diverse learners' needs.

title: Head of Business Operations
description:
**Take over founder-led operations and build the systems that help us grow.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

You might be a consultant who moved into a startup, a founder’s associate already running important parts of a business, or an operator who has started building software and automations yourself.

You enjoy understanding how a business works, finding what slows it down, and making it work better. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, bring people with you, and build the first solution.

We are looking for someone ready to take that ability further: own our operations function, lead a small team, and join the company’s leadership team.

**About us**
------------

Platform Engineering Masters is the company behind platformengineering.org and PlatformCon. We bring together engineers, technology leaders and vendors through our community, conferences, education and Weave Intelligence.

As the business grows, the systems behind it need to grow too: how we deliver for customers, run events, produce content, understand performance and share information across teams.

Our co-founder, Christoph currently leads operations. You will work closely with him during the handover, then take responsibility for running and developing the function independently. You will report to Luca, our Managing Director.

**The challenge**
-----------------

We have a working business, an existing operations team and plenty already being built. We also have manual handovers, disconnected information and processes that depend too much on particular people.

Your job is to decide what needs attention, understand the business problem behind each request, and lead the work through to a solution people actually use.

Some of the questions you will tackle:

* How do we turn a customer commitment into a reliable delivery process across sales, content and events?
* How do we give teams trustworthy information about what is working and where to focus?
* How do we make recurring work, such as publishing a webinar or delivering a sponsored asset, easy to run consistently?
* Which problems need custom software, which need better use of existing tools, and which simply need a clearer process?
* How do we keep improving our systems without making the business dependent on their original builders?

**What you will own**
---------------------

**The operations roadmap.** Work directly with Sales, Growth, Content and Events to understand their needs. Prioritize by business impact, challenge requests where necessary, and make trade-offs explicit, including when requests come from founders.

**A small, growing team.** You will manage our existing revenue operations and systems engineering specialists from the start, and help recruit and develop additional content/design and growth operations capacity.

**Hands-on delivery.** Prototype, write code, connect systems and build automations yourself when that is the fastest way to make progress. Give your team clear direction and space to own delivery.

**Systems that last.** Make sure critical workflows have clear ownership, useful documentation and sensible standards for reliability, access and maintenance.

**Adoption and results.** Work with business teams until the solution is part of their everyday work. Judge success by better delivery, useful information and time saved.

Your remit is the operational systems supporting the business. Functional leaders own their commercial, editorial and event outcomes; you work with them to make those outcomes easier to achieve.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* **Structured problem-solving and strong communication.** You can understand an internal customer’s needs, question assumptions and explain a recommendation clearly. Consulting or similar client-facing experience would be useful.
* **Evidence that you build.** You have used code, APIs, automation or AI tools to solve real problems. You can walk us through what you built, why you chose that approach and what happened when people used it.
* **Commercial judgment.** You connect operational improvements to revenue, delivery quality, cost or capacity.
* **Ownership in an ambiguous environment.** You can make progress without a complete brief and follow through when implementation gets difficult.
* **Readiness to lead.** You can set priorities, give useful feedback and hold a small team accountable while staying close to the work.
* **Curiosity about technology and the business.** You learn unfamiliar tools and domains quickly and care about the quality of the result.

Experience managing processes in a startup would be valuable. You do not need to have held a Head of Operations title or worked in every area this role touches. We care more about your judgment, learning speed and track record than a particular CRM certification or tool stack.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

In your first months, you will establish clear priorities with the team, take ownership of the most important systems and deliver improvements that business teams can see and use.

Over time, routine work will run with fewer manual interventions, teams will have better information, and the founders will be able to step out of day-to-day operations with confidence.

**Why join**
------------

You will inherit a real team, work directly with leadership and have the mandate to shape an important part of a growing business. This is an opportunity to move from solving individual problems to owning the function that solves them.

**Interested?**
---------------

Send us your CV or profile and a short example of something you improved or built. Tell us what the problem was, what you personally did and what changed. If you have any questions, please contact james@platformengineering.org

title: Product Manager On-Ramp & Swap (100% remote)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.
* Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.
* Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.
* Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.
* Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.
* Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.
* Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

**Mandatory:**

* 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)
* 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry
* Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.
* Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.
* Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.
* Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.
* Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.
* Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.
* Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: SDR Manager
description:
**Hybrid**Full time

Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain

**Description**
---------------

We are looking for a hands-on sales development leader to build and run Oppizi's outbound engine from Barcelona. You will manage our SDR team, carry your own pipeline target, and own the outbound motion end to end: lists, sequences, deliverability, coaching, and conversion. If you know outbound as a craft and not just as a dashboard, and you want to build the machine rather than inherit it, we want to hear from you.

**What's Oppizi**

Oppizi is the first major multi-channel player in offline performance marketing. We have built a technology platform that enables the tracking, scaling and optimisation of flyering, door-to-door, direct mail, and insert media campaigns. We operate in 14 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Spain, and more. We are proud to work with flagship accounts such as Uber, DoorDash, Chipotle, Deliveroo, and many others.

Our tech team of 50 is AI-first and ships fast. We are currently building an AI agent platform that will power our product for the next five to ten years, led by a Chief AI Officer who previously worked at NASA and SpaceX. We operate in a category with very few real competitors, against incumbents who are growing at 5% a year.

**The role**

Reporting to the COO, you will lead Oppizi's SDR team in Barcelona and personally contribute to pipeline. This is explicitly a player-coach role. You will spend part of your week prospecting your own accounts and the rest managing, coaching, and building the systems that make the team better.

We do not have a finished outbound playbook. We have strong logos, a differentiated product, and a team that needs a leader who knows how to build sequences that land, coach reps who are ramping, and turn activity into qualified pipeline. That build is the job.

**Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership and Coaching**

* Manage, coach, and develop the Barcelona SDR team, owning ramp, performance, and progression
* Run weekly one-to-ones, call reviews, and pipeline reviews with a consistent methodology
* Set clear activity and outcome KPIs, and hold the team to them
* Build a performance culture grounded in accountability, feedback, and continuous improvement
* Own hiring and onboarding for the SDR team as it grows

**Personal Pipeline (The Player Half)**

* Carry your own quota for qualified meetings and pipeline generated
* Personally prospect into strategic and enterprise accounts, leading by example
* Stay hands-on in the tools every week; you should be writing sequences, not just approving them
* Run discovery calls and hand over cleanly to Account Executives and General Managers

**Outbound engine and process**

* Own the full outbound motion: list building, segmentation, sequencing, multichannel cadence, and follow-up
* Own email deliverability end to end, including domain warming, inbox rotation, and sender reputation
* Continuously test and improve messaging, subject lines, open rates, reply rates, and meeting conversion
* Build the objection handling library and the qualification framework the team runs on
* Partner with Marketing on ICP definition, ABM target lists, and campaign follow-up

**Reporting and Revenue Operations**

* Own CRM hygiene and data quality for the top of the funnel
* Report weekly on activity, pipeline generated, conversion rates, and forecast to the COO
* Run the business off data, not anecdote
* Leverage AI-powered sales tools and Oppizi's internal agent stack to raise team productivity

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* **Know outbound as a craft.** You have personally written the sequences, fixed the deliverability, and cracked the list that finally worked.
* **Coach rather than supervise**. You have taken a ramping SDR and made them good, and you can point to who and how.
* **Lead from the front.** You are comfortable carrying your own number while developing the team around you.
* **Build where there is no playbook.** You bring structure to ambiguity instead of waiting for it to arrive.
* **Move with urgency.** You operate fast, adapt quickly, and prefer shipping to planning.
* **Communicate with precision**. Whether it is a cold email, a call review, or a weekly report, you are clear and credible.
* **Are genuinely ambitious.** You want the next role after this one, and you want to earn it by building something.

**Why should I Apply?**

* **Build the engine, don't inherit it**. There is no outbound playbook here yet. You will write it, and it will carry your fingerprints.
* **Sell a genuinely differentiated product**. Oppizi operates in a category with very few real competitors and serves enterprise clients you already know.
* **Real progression**. This role sits directly under the COO with visibility across the leadership team. Strong performance opens the path to Head of Sales Development or a broader commercial mandate.
* **Work with exceptional people.** We are builders, not politicians. The Oppizi culture values directness, curiosity, and getting things done.
* **Join at the right time**. We are scaling across 14 markets with a growing enterprise client base and significant product investment.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5 to 8 years in B2B sales development or inside sales, with at least 2 years directly managing an SDR or BDR team
* Demonstrable track record of building and scaling an outbound engine in B2B SaaS, MarTech, or AdTech
* Deep hands-on expertise in outbound: sequence design, deliverability, domain and inbox management, multichannel cadence
* Proven coaching ability, with concrete examples of reps you ramped and developed
* Experience prospecting into enterprise or mid-market accounts, not just SMB volume
* Strong command of CRM and outbound tooling; experience with HubSpot, Clay, and Lemlist is a strong plus
* Comfortable being measured on both team output and a personal number
* Fluent English is mandatory. Fluency in either French or German is also required, while Spanish is a strong plus.
* Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate. This is an on-site role
* Comfortable with occasional international travel

**Benefits**
------------

**Compensation**

* Competitive base salary.
* Annual performance bonus.
* Employee stock options.

**Benefits**

* Private health insurance (Alan) after successful completion of probation.
* 22 days annual leave plus 3 additional convenio days.
* Two paid volunteer days each year.

**Flexibility**

* Hybrid working model with four days per week in our Barcelona office.
* Occasional opportunities to work remotely from another location.
* Right to disconnect outside working hours, except in exceptional business situations.

Only candidates who have been selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative: Postdoctoral Researcher in TGV Metallization and Seed-Layer Processes
description:
As part of the **PICs@ICFO Strategic Initiative**, ICFO coordinates PIXEurope, a flagship **Pilot Line funded under the European Chips JU program**, focused on Advanced Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) through which ICFO is advancing frontier technologies, including optical interposers for Co-packaged optics for next-generation optoelectronic and photonic devices.

To strengthen this initiative, ICFO is seeking a highly motivated Engineer/Scientist with strong expertise in thin-film deposition and metallization of high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias (TGVs).

**Position Overview:**,

We offer a post-doctoral position to a scientist with hands-on experience in thin-film deposition, surface preparation, and metallization for semiconductor, MEMS, or advanced-packaging applications. The successful candidate will develop, optimize, and scale reliable adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed layers inside high-aspect-ratio glass vias, ensuring continuity and compatibility with subsequent copper plating and interconnection processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**,

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Develop and optimize seed-layer deposition processes for high-aspect-ratio Through-Glass Vias
* Develop substrate cleaning, glass-surface activation, and adhesion-promotion processes
* Develop adhesion, barrier, and conductive seed stacks such as Ti/Cu, Cr/Cu, TiW/Cu, and related systems
* Optimize sputtering, evaporation, electroless, ALD or CVD-assisted, and hybrid deposition approaches
* Achieve continuous and conformal seed coverage along via entrances, sidewalls, and exits
* Characterize thickness, morphology, resistivity, adhesion, continuity, and wafer-level uniformity
* Identify and mitigate shadowing, seed discontinuity, oxidation, delamination, and cracking
Coordinate with the laser and glass team to align via geometry and surface condition with seeding, plating, and interconnection requirements  

  
This position will report to the **Prof. Dr. Valerio Pruneri, Director of the European Chips JU Pilot Line PIXEurope.**

PIXEurope is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of the Participating States, Spain, Ireland, The Netherlands, Finland, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Austria, France, Italy, United Kingdom. In particular, it is co-funded by Spain through the Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service under reference CJU-010000-2025-0005, as part of the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan (PRTR).

Applicants must hold a PhD in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, microelectronics, physics, microengineering, or related fields, or equivalent research experience.

Candidates should demonstrate expertise in the following areas (not all mandatory, but strongly preferred):

* Thin-film deposition by sputtering, evaporation, ALD, CVD, or electroless methods
* Metallization processes for semiconductor, MEMS, microfabrication, or advanced-packaging applications
* Surface preparation, activation, and surface chemistry of glass or dielectric materials
* Metal-to-dielectric adhesion and adhesion/barrier/seed-layer material systems
* Metallization or coating of high-aspect-ratio three-dimensional structures
* Redistribution layer patterning and fabrication
* Electrical and structural characterization of thin films and interconnects
* Cleanroom processes, safety procedures, and fabrication protocols
Process optimization, reproducibility, failure analysis, and wafer-level uniformity  

Desired (but not required):

* Direct experience with Through-Glass Via or Through-Silicon Via metallization
* Experience with FIB/SEM cross-sections, X-ray inspection, four-point-probe measurements, or via-resistance testing
* Experience with reliability testing, thermomechanical stress, process scale-up, or wafer-level packaging
* Experience with glass surface processing will be evaluated as a strong asset
Experience with electroless deposition, ALD-assisted seeding, or electroplating  

**What We Offer**

* Full time contract up to 3 years (ASE (Accés al Sistema Espanyol de Ciència i Innovació) contract pursuant to Spanish Law 14/2011)
* Access to state-of-the-art microfabrication and characterization facilities
* A dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment
* Opportunities to work on high-impact projects bridging fundamental research and real-world applications
A family allowance may be granted to candidates with dependents, according to ICFO policies.  

**Equal Opportunity**

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

To apply, please submit your:

* resume,
* a cover letter outlining your experience,
contact information for 2 professional references.  

  
Applications should be submitted via the ICFOjobs platform http://jobs.icfo.eu.

The selection process is conducted in accordance with ICFO’s Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) Policy, ensuring equal opportunities, transparency, and fair treatment for all applicants. Candidates are assessed exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, experience, skills, achievements, and potential in relation to the requirements of the position. Further information on the recruitment principles and procedures, conflict of interest and the appeals mechanism available to candidates, can be found in the OTM-R Policy.

The selection process will consist of:

2. Assessment of merits (education, experience, and language)

The Evaluation Committee will include at least three members and ensure gender balance and impartiality.
  
Each phase will be documented, and candidates will be notified of the outcome within 15 days of the interview.

For formal enquiries regarding the application process, please contact: jobs@icfo.eu

For project and technology enquiries, please contact: valerio.pruneri@icfo.eu.

* Build, lead and inspire a team of Key Account and/or Territory Managers to cover the Spanish and Portuguese markets
* Build capability in key account management and value-based selling
* Set clear objectives, coach performance, and create a high-performance culture built on accountability and customer focus.
* Take accountability for ensuring compliance with all relevant veterinary medicines regulations across both markets, working closely with Regulatory Affairs and the Responsible Person.

**Commercial Strategy**

* Build and own the local commercial strategy, defining long-term direction for growth across our species portfolios.
* Identify and prioritise high-value opportunities, including new product launches, category expansion, shifts in customer behaviour, and customer group consolidation.
* Ensure strategic alignment with European and global business priorities.
* Define and continuously review the route to market.
* Move quickly to take advantage of fast-moving market opportunities – such as competitor out-of-stock situations, special import opportunities, and short-term supply gaps – to capture volume and grow market share.
* Monitor the competitive landscape, competitor pricing, and wider market trends, using this insight to anticipate threats and identify new sources of growth.

  

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Oversee relationships with key veterinary corporate groups, buying groups, wholesalers/distributors, and integrators.
* Support Key Account Managers in developing robust joint business plans that deliver growth, category performance, and compliance.
* Guide the team through complex price, volume, and contract negotiations, ensuring sustainable long-term partnerships.
* Oversee all customer contracts and trading agreements being put in place, ensuring terms are clearly documented, commercially sound, and consistently applied across the customer base.
* Apply robust segmentation across customers to ensure focus remains on highest potential customers and products
  

**Performance Management**

* Drive delivery of revenue, margin, and market share targets across Iberia
* Lead accurate demand and sales forecasting, pipeline management, and performance analysis across product segments.
* Ensure pricing, promotional execution, and investment decisions maximise profitability and ROI
* Enable robust gross-to-net (GTN) % evolution and customer-focused rebate management programmes, evolving our go-to-market model where required
* Ensure all customer rebates, discounts, and promotional offers are monitored, accurately accrued, and fully accounted for, so that the true net cost of trade investment is understood and controlled.
* Work with Finance to manage customer credit, debtor days, and working capital, ensuring agreed trading terms are adhered to and overdue accounts are actively managed.
  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Marketing, Technical teams, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure seamless execution of commercial plans.
* Partner with technical and marketing teams to strengthen value propositions and enhance customer outcomes.
* Represent the Iberian markets in regional planning forums, providing market insight and commercial recommendations.

  

**Experience & Skills Required**

Industry Experience

* Strong understanding of veterinary and agricultural channels, including corporate groups, wholesalers, and integrators
* Direct experience of the Spanish and/or Portuguese animal health market, with an established network across veterinary corporate groups, buying groups, and distributors.
* Knowledge of the livestock and equine production-animal sectors, and a working understanding of the Spanish (AEMPS) and Portuguese (DGAV) veterinary medicines regulatory frameworks.

  

Commercial & Leadership Experience

* Proven track record in senior commercial or national sales roles, dealing with large veterinary and trade customers
* Experience managing and developing high-performing commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ability to shape and execute commercial strategy at country or regional level.
* Strong financial acumen with the ability to interpret sales data, margin performance, and investment impact.
* Strong contract negotiation skills, with experience structuring customer agreements, rebates, and trading terms, and a working understanding of the veterinary medicines regulatory environment.
* Third-level qualification in a science, veterinary, agricultural, business, or commercial discipline; a relevant postgraduate or commercial qualification is an advantage.
* Fluency in Spanish is essential; working proficiency in Portuguese is a strong advantage. Professional fluency in English is required for reporting and collaboration within Bimeda’s European and global organisation.

  

**About Bimeda**

Bimeda is a leading global innovator, manufacturer and marketer of veterinary pharmaceuticals and animal health products and has over half a century’s experience in providing science-driven solutions to optimize the health, wellbeing and productivity of the world’s animals.

Bimeda’s global innovation program sees six state-of-the art R&D centers across four continents collaborate on an enviable product development pipeline which anticipates the ever-evolving needs of the animal health industry.

Bimeda’s nine manufacturing facilities across seven countries allow the company to manufacture a broad range of preventative, curative and nutritional products including sterile injectables, vaccinations, nutritional boluses, feed additives, tablets, water-soluble powders, pastes and non-sterile liquids.

Globally, the company focuses on the development, manufacture and commercialization of quality Bimeda-branded products while also being the partner of choice for contract manufacturing and R&D services for prominent companies within the animal health industry.

In collaboration with Medical and Market Access teams to develop proposals and business cases for further data generation and RWE.

* Finally, build the Stakeholder mapping

* Profound understanding of drug development and commercialization in rare disease

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across matrix teams and achieve goals by delivering through others.
* Proven experience and knowledge of a broad base of external partners and customers including patients, prescribers, payors, providers and in/out license partners.

* Experienced with key global regulations in the field of pharmaceutical compliance and commercialization, including pharmacovigilance
* Excellent communications skills across a diverse set of stakeholders (commercial, clinical, medical, etc.)
* AI experience integrating tools into cross-functional workflows to improve strategic decision-making, efficiency and business impact

* You can integrate a variety of perspectives into meaningful strategies and programs.

description:
**Key Account Manager - Wholesalers**

Description: Responsible for the strategic development and profitable growth of the wholesaler channel in Spain.

  

**Purpose:**

The Key Account Manager – Wholesalers will play a pivotal role in accelerating Bayer Consumer Health growth through the indirect route to market in Spain. The role will respond to the need to strengthen distribution and reach in non-visited pharmacies through the wholesaler channel.

The KAM will translate market, customer and distribution insights into clear account plans, manage customer relationships and deliver profitable growth with assigned wholesalers, directly influencing more than 25% of the Consumer Health business in Spain.

The role reports to the Head of Sales Spain and works cross-functionally with key internal stakeholders across Sales, Brand Marketing, Trade Marketing, Finance, Logistics and Order to Cash.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Own the commercial relationship with assigned wholesaler customers for Bayer Consumer Health brands, acting as the primary point of contact.

2. Develop and execute strategic account plans based on customer potential, market insights, channel dynamics, distribution opportunities and commercial priorities.

3. Lead annual negotiations and joint business planning, securing sustainable agreements that balance customer value, sales growth, profitability, market share and brand objectives.

4. Build trusted relationships with customer decision-makers and develop a strong internal stakeholder network to align priorities, remove barriers and accelerate execution.

5. Ensure end-to-end execution of commercial agreements through clear follow-up with customers and internal teams, translating account plans into concrete actions and measurable outcomes.

6. Co-create and execute annual promotional and activation calendars with Trade Marketing and Marketing, including assortment strategy, innovation launches, offline and online visibility, and promotional effectiveness.

7. Monitor account performance through clear KPIs, customer P&Ls and regular business reviews; identify risks and opportunities and take corrective action to deliver commitments.

8. Maintain a strong customer-contact rhythm throughout the year, including regular customer reviews and field contact where relevant, and champion a superior customer experience across physical and digital touchpoints.

  

**Main Objectives of the Role:**

Accelerate profitable growth through the wholesaler channel in Spain, strengthening distribution and execution for Bayer Consumer Health brands in non-visited pharmacies.

Secure consistent visibility and execution for Bayer Consumer Health brands across assigned wholesaler customers and the pharmacies served through this channel.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic mindset: translates market, channel and customer insights into focused account strategies and clear priorities.

* Strong drive for results: takes ownership, maintains pace and converts plans into measurable commercial outcomes.

* Customer focus and relationship building: establishes credibility and trusted partnerships with customer stakeholders.

* Influencing and collaboration: aligns cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

* Negotiation and commercial acumen: prepares scenarios, understands value drivers, protects profitability and reaches sustainable win-win agreements.

* Planning, analytical thinking and complexity management: prioritizes effectively, uses data to make decisions and manages multiple workstreams with discipline and clarity.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Courage and ownership

* Learning agility and innovation

**Education and Experience:**

* University degree required; business, economics, marketing or a related field preferred.
* 3-5 years of experience as a Key Account Manager within the pharmaceutical industry, with deep knowledge of the pharmaceutical wholesaler channel and a proven track record of managing strategic customer relationships and leading complex commercial negotiations.

* Proven ability to build customer relationships, negotiate complex agreements and deliver ambitious sales and profitability targets.

* Strong analytical and financial skills, including scenario planning, forecasting, profitability analysis and customer P&L management.

* Demonstrated success in managing multiple priorities and influencing cross-functional teams.

* High degree of autonomy, sound judgment and disciplined prioritization.

* Strong attention to detail while maintaining a clear strategic perspective.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt messages to different audiences.

* High energy, resilience and perseverance in a fast-paced environment.

* Fluency in Spanish and English is required.

title: Medical Director - All European Countries
description:
***Applications are welcome from all European Union countries, as we are pleased to consider candidates located across Europe.***

Are you looking for an exciting and fulfilling new position? Join our dynamic team at WEP Clinical, where your contributions will play a key role in driving impactful solutions and improving outcomes for clients and patients. We encourage innovation and collaboration, challenging our team to bring ideas that make a real difference. Be part of a mission-driven organisation dedicated to advancing clinical research and transforming lives.

  

**Role Objectives:**

The **Medical Director** at WEP Clinical serves as the primary medical and scientific expert for clinical trial protocols and Expanded Access Programs (EAPs), playing a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and successful execution of studies. As the protocol expert, the Medical Director is responsible for guiding investigators and internal/external teams in implementing and adhering to the study protocol. title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing

Town Web · HeyGov  
Remote · Full-time contractor

**The Quick Version**

Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts?

We did!

Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry!

Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring.

Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.

Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.

Here's a video to tell you more about this role!

**The details**

Who we are

We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.

Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)

We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.

What you'll own

* Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
* Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured.
* Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
* Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
* The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
* Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.

Who does well here

Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? Are you “THE ONE?”

We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.

And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.

AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.

This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.

What we need to see

* Exceptional Enthusiasm
* Extremely Creative Energy
* You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
* You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
* AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
* Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
* Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
* B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!

How to apply

* Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
* There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!

  
**Requirements**  
  
**IMPORTANT**

* Only applications submitted through the proper channel, which is Workable, will be processed.
* Taking the CultureIndex Survey is a requirement, we will not respond to any applications submitted without this.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a **Senior Marketing Strategist** who thinks like a strategist, creative person and optimizer—someone who understands customer behavior, identifies growth opportunities, and continuously improves marketing performance through experimentation.

You'll be responsible for developing new funnels, conducting market and competitor research, generating hypotheses, managing A/B testing initiatives, and collaborating closely with Creative, Media Buying, Analytics, and IT teams to deliver measurable business results.

Success in this role means constantly asking "How can we improve conversion?" and using data to find the answer.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct market, audience, and competitor research for new and existing clients.
* Develop new landing page concepts and marketing funnels.
* Generate, prioritize, and document CRO hypotheses.
* Plan and manage A/B testing roadmaps across multiple clients.
* Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.
* Collaborate with Copywriters, Designers, Video Producers, IT, and Media Buyers throughout the production process.
* Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
* Identify winning strategies and scale them across similar clients and industries.
* Maintain and expand the company's CRO knowledge base and testing library.
* Research new marketing trends, technologies, and customer acquisition strategies.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
* Present recommendations and optimization plans to internal stakeholders.

You actively use AI to improve research, productivity, and decision-making. Whether it's generating hypotheses, analyzing competitors, organizing knowledge, or accelerating content creation, you view AI as a strategic assistant rather than a replacement for marketing thinking.

* 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.

**Responsibilities**

Acts strategically to generate opportunity and value for the asset or indication to optimize benefit risk and maintain a competitive advantage. Line manages a team of safety physicians and / or scientists. They will be required at times to deputise for the Global Safety Head.

The Global Safety Program Lead, Senior Director will operate according to the highest ethical, quality and compliance standards in compliance as provided by global and local regulations, GxP practice and AZ procedures.

**You will be responsible for:**

**Safety Expert**

* Accountable for the overall scientific and clinical safety content for the assigned asset(s) or indications.

* Accountable for the implementation and the high quality delivery of the Safety & Strategy Management Team (SSaMT) and Safety Surveillance Team for assigned asset(s).

* Responsible for overall safety content for the product or indication(s) aligned to GPT strategy. Sets safety team goals aligned to TA and product strategy.

* For the assigned asset(s), accountable for safety TPP, Safety Go/No Go criteria, safety communication/messaging and the guidelines for toxicity management of the asset

* Is accountable for project representation for Global Patient Safety at governance and other forums where safety is involved, eg DRC, eCRC, SARB, FSIRB, and DSMB/DMC, Medical Affairs Review Committees (MARC), product teams such CPT and GPT and Advisory Board meetings in partnership with GSH.

* Accountable for the quality of key safety deliverables e.g., Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and Periodic Safety Reports (PSRs), compliance and adherence to PV regulations of the assigned asset(s).

* Leads response to complex technical issues for specific safety aspects for the assigned asset(s).

* Is accountable for safety contribution to study designs and study concept delivery within their assigned program

* Through integrated understanding of the product strategy, provides strategic safety knowledge and support to the safety medical directors and scientists through initiation, execution, and completion of the clinical programs for the assigned asset(s).

* Leads the safety physicians and scientists to support the safety strategy and input into the program design, monitoring, and data interpretation from pre-clinical and clinical studies, communication and post-marketing surveillance, epidemiology, pre-clinical and literature, epidemiology for each asset.

* Ensures that own work and work of team is compliant with Safety Health and Environment (SHE) standards and all other relevant internal and external regulations and standards.

* Represents the Company and accountable for the quality of safety delivery e.g., regulatory submissions, answers to Health Authority Queries, Ethic Committees, Marketing Companies, investigators/sites, and provides clarifications as well as solves safety issues in the study team.

* May be required to support in-licensing opportunities.

* Promotes and enables cross-functional, proactive and solutions-orientated team actions and behaviours

* Accountable for implementation of new processes, systems and learning, including new ways of working.

* Prioritizes risk mitigation strategies and effective trouble shooting.

* Line manages a team of safety physicians and / or scientists.

**Scientific clinical safety analytical accountabilities**
