title: Principal Systems Designer, Live Service (Social Systems, Events and Onboarding) | Fully Remote
description:
**What we are looking for:**

We are building the live-service meta for an upcoming game, and three of its most important systems do not yet have a principal design owner: the events that give the game a weekly heartbeat, the social structures that make progression something players do together rather than alone, and the onboarding that has to teach both. This role owns the first two outright and is the design partner on the third.

This is a design, maintain, and iterate role. Our event event architecture, our LiveOps operating model, and our community structures are about to be defined. You would be the person driving those and designing them, alongside the other Designers, PM and UX team.

This is a fully remote, principal-level individual contributor role on the Meta & Live Service team, reporting to the Design Director, Meta & Live Service.

  

**What we will do together:**

**Events and LiveOps design systems**

* Design events: a growing set of reusable, configurable formats that scale to a meet our audience needs.
* Design events end to end: entry conditions, currencies, consumables, reward pacing, and how events feed and are fed by the wider meta rather than sitting beside it.
* Assist in defining the configuration surfaces and tooling requirements that make running an event a config job rather than an engineering job.
* Help set the standard for how events are specced, instrumented, reviewed and iterated after they run, and retired.

  

**Social and community systems**

* Design various community and social systems that will help curate a strong community that grows together.
* Partner with the various teams to see how each feature can be added to a social layer.
* Design the end-to-end social funnel experience

  

**Onboarding partnership**

* Partner with the FTUE pod and designer to sequence meta systems into onboarding
* Define nudge, notification and re-entry logic, including the return path for lapsed players.
* Help define the telemetry that tells us whether onboarding taught what it was supposed to teach.

  

**What you will bring:**

* 8+ years in game design, including 4+ years designing for and operating a live-service title after launch. Post-launch operating experience matters more here than shipping experience.
* Demonstrated ownership of event systems, social systems, or both, on a title you supported live, not only specced.
* Fluency in progression and economy design. You can build and defend the model, not only describe the intent.
* A track record of designing systems that scale through templates and configuration rather than through bespoke content per beat.
* Comfort influencing across Production, Engineering, UX, Narrative and Product without formal authority, and the judgement to know which decisions are yours and which are not.
* Genuine use of telemetry and player feedback to iterate on live systems, including examples of things you changed because the data disagreed with you.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.

**Nice to have**

* Tools and configuration design experience: you have specced the editor, not only used it.
* You have run a live game through a rough stretch and can talk specifically about what you changed and what you would do differently.

**Interested… a bit about Escape Velocity:**

Escape Velocity is a team of passionate, talented developers working at a studio that offers excellent benefits, on what we believe is a once-in-a-career project with a committed publisher. * Write clean, modular, well-documented code, and maintain it over time
* Profile and optimize gameplay for performance, memory and stability across a wide range of mobile devices
* Lead debugging of complex gameplay issues and help resolve them across the codebase

* Work closely with artists, designers, product and other programmers to understand requirements and contribute creatively to development

title: IAM Transformation Lead
description:
A multi-company group is building its IAM capability across several portfolio companies, each with its own IT function. The governance framework, the target operating model and the IAM control set are designed, and selection of an IGA platform is in the last stages of an RFP.

This role takes that foundation and turns it into something that operates: a platform in production, applications onboarded, roles defined, and controls producing evidence on a cadence. It is a build role in a federated group, not the stewardship of an established function. The person joining inherits a programme in motion, with the design work done and the delivery ahead of them.

#### **How the role operates**

The function is new and has no precedent to inherit. There is no IAM function above this role to escalate into, and for most decisions there is no prior ruling to point at. The role sets its own agenda, brings its own proposals to the forums it runs.

The role leads a project team of two IAM business analysts and three IAM integration engineers. It is not a solo role, but it is the only role accountable for the outcome. The holder sets the team's direction and priorities and carries the programme themselves, with no programme manager or PMO between them and delivery.

#### **Purpose of the role**

Own the IAM Target Operating Model end to end, from governance framework and control design through to delivery of the IAM platform and its adoption across the portfolio companies. Lead the IAM project team. Accountable for the group IAM maturity position and for the regulatory and internal compliance behind it.

### **Key responsibilities**

**Leading the team**  

* Lead a project team of two IAM business analysts and three IAM integration engineers, setting direction, priorities and the expected standard of work.
* Allocate the team across governance workstreams and platform integration, and rebalance as the programme moves from design into delivery.
* Build the team's capability in a function where most practices are being established for the first time.
* Hold the implementation partner and any managed services to the same standard as the internal team.

**Programme delivery and IAM platform**  

* Set the IAM programme agenda and bring proposals and decisions to the governance forums, rather than waiting for direction.
* Own delivery of the IAM platform implementation: scope, plan, milestones, budget and dependencies, with no PMO to carry them.
* Direct the implementation partner and managed services alongside the internal integration capacity.
* Translate IAM requirements into platform configuration, and own the decisions where the two do not match.
* Own application onboarding across the in-scope portfolio: sequencing, connector delivery, testing and cutover.
* Own the commercial relationship after signature, including licence metric, identity counts, true-ups and change control.
* Report delivery progress, risks and decisions to the steering committee and to executive stakeholders.

**Governance, policy and operating model**  

* Own and maintain the IAM policies, standards and procedures.
* Own the IAM Target Operating Model across process, tooling and organisation.
* Define IAM decision rights, accountabilities and escalation paths, and keep them current as the function grows.
* Ensure alignment with regulatory and internal requirements, including ISO 27001 and DORA.

**Risk, control and compliance**  

* Own the IAM control set: control objectives, design, execution cadence and evidence model.
* Move the controls from design into operation, and from Test of Design through to Test of Effectiveness.
* Own the IAM risk register and exception management.
* Coordinate IAM audits and regulatory reviews.
* Own the group IAM maturity position against the parent company's IAM maturity framework, including the annual self-assessment and the agreed maturity trajectory.
* Define and track IAM KPIs and maturity metrics.

**Portfolio company engagement**  

* Secure adoption of the group IAM operating model across the portfolio companies, each with its own IT function and its own priorities.
* Get IAM domain owners, business owners and application owners named, and keep them engaged in reviews, approvals and authorization concepts.
* Work with HR, service desk and infrastructure teams in each company on the joiner, mover and leaver process and the data behind it.
* Operate through influence rather than line authority across company boundaries.

**Role and access model**  

* Own the business role model: design principles, taxonomy, eligibility and lifecycle.
* Own authorization concepts across the in-scope applications, and the application criticality and entitlement risk classification behind them.
* Own segregation of duties: rule design, conflict analysis and exception handling.

**Oversight and reporting**  

* Approve deviations and exceptions to IAM standards.
* Provide guidance to the portfolio companies and application owners.
* Report IAM posture, risk and progress to senior management and to the parent company.

  

### **What success looks like in the first twelve months**

* The IAM platform is in production, with the first wave of applications connected.
* The Priority controls are operating on their defined cadence and producing evidence.
* Authorization concepts are approved across the in-scope application portfolio.
* IAM domain owners are named and active in every portfolio company.
* The group maturity position has reached the agreed target.
* The programme plan for the following year is set, funded and agreed with the steering committee, on the holder's own proposal.

### **Required experience and expertise**

* 8+ years in IAM, information security, governance or risk, with at least 2 years in a lead or ownership role.
* Evidence of having built an IAM or control function where one did not exist, rather than taking over one that was already running.
* Delivery of at least one IGA platform implementation end to end, including vendor and implementation partner management.
* Experience leading a mixed team of analysts and engineers, setting priorities across governance and technical delivery at the same time.
* Able to run the programme as its own project manager: plan, milestones, budget, risks and steering, with no PMO behind them.
* Able to get decisions out of senior stakeholders who do not report to them, and to keep those decisions made.
* Deep working knowledge of IAM: joiner, mover and leaver, role and entitlement design, segregation of duties, access reviews and privileged access.
* Experience operating in complex, federated or multi-entity organisations, where adoption is negotiated rather than mandated.
* Comfortable working directly with access data: able to take a large directory or application extract and turn it.

into a finding or a role model without waiting for someone else to analyse it.  

* Experience with regulatory and control frameworks, and with audit and evidence expectations.
* Proven stakeholder management at executive level, and the ability to put IAM risk in business terms.
* Languages: English mandatory, Spanish and German are a plus.

### **Desirable**

* Experience reporting into a parent company against a defined maturity framework.
* Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory at multi-tenant or multi-forest scale.
* HR-driven identity lifecycle from an HCM platform.
* Privileged access management implementation experience.

**We offer\*:**

* Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location-specific benefits

* not applicable for freelancers

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

title: Compliance Centre Lead
description:
**Job Title: Compliance Centre Lead**

**Job Purpose:**  
The Compliance Centre Lead is the enterprise leader of GSK’s global Compliance Centre. The role shapes how the company uses insights, technology, and simplified global processes to deliver a scalable, and auditable case management service that enables business owned risk management and confident, timely decisions. The role reports to Head of Global Function Compliance and Compliance Centre.

  

Acting as a critical enabler of the operating model, the Lead reduces operational burden, surfaces early risk signals, and drives the cultural shift to insight led, business embedded risk management across markets and functions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* **Deliver enterprise leadership for the Compliance Centre:** successfully deliver on the Centre’s mission, scope, operating principles, and value proposition. Align decision rights, service boundaries, and performance standards in line with the Compliance model and strategy.
* **Deliver a consistent, scalable, high-quality global compliance service:** Ensure Centre operations meet defined service standards, governance expectations, and audit requirements. Drive disciplined, data-enabled case management across Privacy, ABAC, Third‑party Risk, Investigations support, CAPA, and other core compliance processes.
* **Own the Centre’s insight generation:** Translate case activity into actionable risk signals and trend insights that inform market prioritisation and enterprise decision‑making. Connect Centre insights to Polaris, Compass, and the Quarterly Risk Report to enable earlier risk surfacing and sharper, market‑level action.
* **Shape the global compliance operating model:** Partner with Compliance leaders, Product Owners, and Technology to evolve processes, platforms, and standards. Champion simplification, harmonisation, and automation at enterprise scale.
* **Lead digital and AI enabled transformation:** Drive adoption and optimisation of case management tooling and analytics, including AI enabled insights, workflow automation, and data comparability to reduce cycle time, improve quality, and unlock capacity.
* **Senior stakeholder leadership and governance influence:** Engage and influence senior governance forums and business leaders to align priorities, resolve complex issues, simplify, and reinforce business ownership of risk supported by Compliance as strategic partner.
* **Governance, escalation, and control effectiveness:** Oversee high-risk escalations and ensure expert involvement, rigorous documentation, audit readiness, and consistent risk-based judgement across Centre operations.
* **Enterprise efficiency and value:** Use data, process design, and technology to reduce duplication and cost, focus effort on the highest‑value activities, and demonstrate measurable business impact.
  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Business Administration, Risk Management, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of professional experience in Compliance, Risk Management, Legal, Investigations, Internal Controls, Audit, or related functions, including at least 5 years in a people leadership role with responsibility for strategy, resource allocation, and team performance.
* Experience leading cross-functional or global teams spanning multiple countries, business units, or functions, including delivery of organizational, process, or technology change initiatives.
* Experience managing or transforming a centralized service delivery, shared services, compliance operations, or governance function, including implementation of process improvements, standardization efforts, or operating model changes.
* experience overseeing compliance case management, investigations, risk assessments, or control processes in accordance with regulatory, governance, audit, and documentation requirements.
* Experience utilizing technology platforms, data analytics, dashboards, or reporting tools to monitor compliance risks, identify trends, support decision-making, and report outcomes to leadership.
* Experience presenting compliance, risk, investigation, or operational findings to executive leaders, governance committees, audit committees, or other senior stakeholders, including development of recommendations and implementation plans.
* Experience coordinating the resolution of cross-functional compliance, risk, governance, or operational issues involving multiple stakeholders, business units, or geographies.
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Masters in a relevant field such as Law, Business, Risk Management, or Data Analytics.
* Experience supporting functional budget stewardship and engaging with third-party suppliers, including contributing to contract discussions, monitoring delivery, and supporting value realisation.
* High degree of personal integrity, sound judgement, and discretion.
  

**Work Arrangements:** This role offers a hybrid working model, with a mix of on-site and remote work. Remote or fully home-working arrangements are not available for this role.

  

**Skills**

Business Acumen, Internal Control Reviews, Problem Solving, Project Management, Risk Management

**Product & Growth Associate**
==============================

**Location:** Barcelona, Spain  
**Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 0-2 years  
**Reports to:** Co-Founder & CTO

**About Acai Travel**
---------------------

Acai Travel is transforming the travel industry with AI agents that automate the complex work travel agents handle today, from flight changes to refunds. Our customers include leading Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) and Travel Management Companies (TMCs) that manage thousands of bookings every month. We help them run faster, leaner and with a better traveler experience.

We're backed by Nauta Capital, Amadeus Ventures, and DraperB1 (raised $5M and soon raising a Series A), with ~20 enterprise customers including Kiwi.com, Etraveli, Air Greenland, and Direct Travel. Acai is co-founded by Riccardo Vittoria, who previously built and sold 30SecondsToFly to American Express Global Business Travel, and Pavel Pratyush (ex-Head of Engineering at ManoMano, ex-CTO of Deporvillage, and ex-eBay).

We're a small, global team across New York, Barcelona and Pune, reimagining how travel works behind the scenes in the age of AI. We're drawn to the hardest problems, because for us they're the most fun part of the job. We take them on with genuine curiosity and zero ego, and keep our sense of "OK-ness" whatever the day throws at us.

Explore our work at www.acaitravel.com.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Product & Growth Associate to work directly with our Co-Founder & CTO. You'll cover the customer lifecycle end to end: getting new customers live, growing existing ones, and creating the material that explains and sells our new flagship product - AcaiDesk.

This role is for someone early in their career (0-2 years) who is exceptionally sharp, hungry and AI-native. You'll learn the whole business at once, from product and market to marketing, onboarding and support, working alongside engineering and customer success.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Onboard new customers.** Get new accounts live on AcaiDesk: run the kickoff, coordinate setup with engineering, train their teams, and make sure the first weeks go well.

**Grow existing customers.** Find where customers can get more out of Acai. Work with engineering to build what they need next, and upsell it to them.

**Create product documentation.** Produce the material that explains and sells the product: documentation, demo videos, onboarding videos and training guides.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**0-2 years of experience, with an engineering or business degree.** Recent graduates are welcome.

**Exceptionally smart.** You learn fast, think clearly, and get to the core of a problem quickly.

**Hungry.** You want more responsibility than you're given, and you go and get it.

**AI-native.** AI is already part of how you work. You use it to get up to speed fast on the product, the market, marketing, onboarding and support.

**Native or near-native English.**

**Why Join Acai**
-----------------

**Work directly with a founder.** You'll work side by side with our Co-Founder & CTO from day one, across customers, product and go-to-market.

**Work that moves the needle.** Onboarding, customer growth and product marketing drive our revenue and retention, and you'll be in the middle of all three. As Acai grows, so does your role.

**Customers from day one.** ~20 enterprise customers, including some of the largest TMCs and OTAs in the world. You'll work with them directly.

**Founders who've done it.** Our team has built and exited in this space before, with the network and judgment that comes with it.

**A team that takes the work, and each other, seriously.** Small, senior, global. Low ego, high standards, and a culture that prioritizes growth as a person, not just as an operator.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We have 13 languages, 9 nationalities, and many religions: a diverse global team by nature, not by design.

description:
Madrid, Spain | Full time | Home-based | R1573009

  

**Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient & Site Strategy** helps organizations understand how patients feel and function in clinical research and routine care. The team develops and manages the instruments used to capture patient experience, oversees permissions and licensing, and guides the evolution and integration of patient- and site-facing technologies with electronic health records.

  
  

**Patient Science, Instrument Development and Thought Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------------

Patient Science, Instrument R&D and Thought Leadership develops new clinical outcome assessment instruments and expands or enhances existing instruments, with emphasis on priority therapeutic areas and market gaps. Drawing on deep expertise in instrument development, scientific consulting, and delivery, the team supports client engagements in collaboration with Patient and Clinical Technology (PACT), IQVIA Laboratories, digital-measure scientists, imaging-measurement scientists, COA managers and therapeutic-area centers of excellence. The team also advances thought leadership through white papers, peer-reviewed publications, books, posters, and podium presentations, working closely with clients, regulators, patient advocacy organizations, industry experts, and other stakeholders.

  
  

**Position**

Composite and companion measures represent an important advance in measuring what matters to patients. By integrating multiple sources of evidence, they help move health care and clinical research beyond measures of service utilization toward a more complete understanding of meaningful outcomes.

This role leads the strategic, scientific, and regulatory development of laboratory- and genomic-enabled composite and companion measures in partnership with IQVIA Labs and external partners. These solutions are designed for use by biopharmaceutical and medical-device organizations in clinical trials and real-world studies, as well as by health care professionals in routine clinical practice.

The Senior Director ensures that the patient perspective is rigorously measured and incorporated into drug-development strategy, laboratory and genomic research, clinical outcome assessment endpoint strategy, regulatory submissions, and commercialization through the application of behavioral and measurement science.

  
  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Director Composite Measures Science & Integration leads the design, development, validation, and implementation of scientifically rigorous composite and companion measurement solutions in partnership with IQVIA Labs and external partners. The role supports corporate strategy, client requirements, global clinical trials, real-world research, and patient-facing care by integrating clinical outcome assessments, digital measures, laboratory and genomic data, and emerging technologies into meaningful endpoints and scalable service offerings aligned with market needs and the IQVIA solutions portfolio.

  
  

**Strategic and Scientific Leadership**
---------------------------------------

Set the strategy, scientific direction, and operating model for Laboratory & Genomic composite and companion measure development.

Partner with IQVIA Labs scientific team and external partners on scientific evolution and market needs.

Assess the feasibility and value of applying measurement science, laboratory methods, digital technologies, and novel data sources to products and services.

Align measurement research and development priorities with corporate strategy, business objectives, client needs, regulatory expectations, and market dynamics.

Maintain expert knowledge of developments in drug development, clinical outcome assessment, digital health technology, laboratory science, genomics, patient care, and relevant regulatory guidance.

Serve as a recognized internal and external scientific authority and as the primary technical contact for complex, cross-functional contracts and projects.

  
  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Direct the end-to-end development, validation, integration, and delivery of composite measures that combine laboratory, genomic and other clinically relevant data with patient-reported, clinician-reported and digital outcome data.
* Ensure that COA data collection, digital-measure data, laboratory operations, and associated deliverables meet applicable scientific, quality, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead research design and execution, including validation protocols, analytical methods, technical reports, troubleshooting strategies, and short- and long-term project goals.
* Oversee the evaluation and validation of relevant laboratory measurement instruments and methods, including installation, operational, and performance qualification documentation, as appropriate in collaboration with IQVIA Labs and external partners.
* Ensure the high-quality, timely delivery of clinical research and health care solutions while maintaining exceptional standards of client service.
* Use performance indicators, process analysis and AI to improve efficiency, scalability, cost control, resource utilization, and readiness for growth.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives and collaborate with therapeutic-area experts, consulting teams, regulators, clients, patient advocacy organizations, industry thought leaders, technology partners, and other stakeholders.

**Innovation, Publications, and Partnerships**
----------------------------------------------

* Translate scientific and technological advances into differentiated service offerings for clinical research and patient-facing care.
* Advance scientific literature and industry dialogue through peer-reviewed manuscripts, abstracts, posters, podium presentations, white papers, books, patent applications, and scientifically accurate marketing materials.
* Lead or support the development of intellectual property, vendor agreements, research collaborations, and strategic partnerships.
* Identify proactive client solutions that create scientific value, strengthen market differentiation, and support sustainable revenue growth.
  

  

**People and Operational Leadership**
-------------------------------------

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team through effective recruitment, onboarding, training, mentorship, performance management, and succession planning.
* Foster a unified culture of collaboration, information sharing, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and manage operating budgets, resource plans, cost-control standards, and capacity strategies.
* Partner with Quality Assurance and operational teams to implement effective quality programs, address performance issues promptly, and maintain current procedures and staff capabilities.
* Manage staff in accordance with organizational policies and applicable regulations, including work planning, assignment, professional development, employee relations, and appropriate human-resources actions.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* At least 15 years of relevant experience, including substantial experience in scientific method development, clinical laboratory or drug-development solutions, and people leadership.
* Comprehensive knowledge of scientific principles, measurement theory, method development, drug development, and relevant state-of-the-art instrumentation and technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries, lead multiple workstreams, manage complex projects, and communicate effectively with clients and senior leaders.
* Strong organizational, interpersonal, analytical, presentation, and client-management capabilities, with the ability to translate scientific insight into practical, scalable, and commercially relevant solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and ensure that they are performed in a quality manner.
* Strong knowledge of the BioPharma drug development industry and applying that knowledge to the improvement of their business unit.
* Effective communication and presentation skills to influence at various levels of the business, including senior leadership.
* Skill in extracting relevant data to measure performance indicators and proactively plan for growth and scalability.

Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. **Where you'll work**

### **Home-based**

You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.

Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Manager** to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

**Vision & Strategy**

* Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
* Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
* Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

**Technical Product Leadership**

* Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.
* Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.
* Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.
* Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

**Rapid Prototyping with AI**

* Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.
* Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

**Execution & Team Leadership**

* Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.
* Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.
* Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.
* Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

**Mobile & Distribution**

* Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.
* Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.
* Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

**Mandatory:**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.
* Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).
* Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.
* Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.
* Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

* Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.
* A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.
* You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have:**

* Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

* Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.
* A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.
* Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).
* A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.
* An engineering background or computer science degree.
* Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

**Why this role:**

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Social Media Lead - SportyTV & Sports Media Brands
description:
**About Sporty Group**
----------------------

Sporty Group is a global sports entertainment company, home to leading brands like **SportyBet**, **Football.com** and **SportyTV**. We operate at the intersection of **sports, content, community and technology**, building products and media experiences that connect fans with the moments that matter.

Our media brands, led by **SportyTV**, bring fans closer to the game through highlights, stories, analysis, personalities and football culture, across every major social platform.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We're looking for a **Social Media Lead** to drive social strategy and coordinate the social team behind **SportyTV and our sports media brands**. This role combines **team leadership**, a **sports journalism mindset** and **strong editorial judgement** to make our channels a go-to destination for football fans.

You'll set the editorial direction, run day-to-day publishing operations, and lead a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators, making sure our output is **fast, accurate, engaging and built for growth**.

You'll work closely with **Content, Video/Production, Design, Brand, Marketing, Partnerships, BI and Country teams**, and report to the Social Media Director.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Team Leadership & Coordination**

* Lead, coordinate and develop a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators across SportyTV and our media brands.
* Set priorities, assign coverage and run workflows and shift planning for match days, live events and breaking news.
* Give clear feedback, run regular editorial meetings and raise the team's creative and editorial standards.
* Build scalable processes (calendars, briefs, approval flows, playbooks) that keep the team fast and consistent.

### **Editorial Strategy & Sports Coverage**

* Define and execute the social and editorial strategy for **SportyTV and Football.com**, aligned with global brand guidelines and business priorities.
* Own the editorial calendar around major football and sports moments (EPL, UCL, LaLiga, AFCON, World Cup, transfer windows, etc.).
* Apply a journalistic approach to social: newsworthiness, storytelling, fact-checking, source verification and speed without sacrificing accuracy.
* Lead real-time and reactive coverage of match days, breaking news, transfers, controversies and trending moments.

### **Content & Formats**

* Oversee content across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube (incl. Shorts), LinkedIn and Telegram.
* Develop and scale repeatable content series and franchises: highlights-led narratives, analysis, interviews, explainers, football culture and personality-led formats.
* Work with video, production and design teams to deliver platform-native content with strong hooks and retention.
* Ensure tone of voice, quality and brand consistency across all channels.

### **Community & Audience Growth**

* Drive follower growth, engagement and watch time across SportyTV and media brand channels.
* Oversee community management: comments, DMs, moderation, sentiment monitoring and escalation of sensitive issues.
* Spot local relevance opportunities across our key markets and global football audiences.

### **Talent, Creators & Partnerships**

* Work with presenters, journalists, pundits, creators and sports personalities to grow reach and credibility.
* Support partnerships, rights-holder relationships and co-branded activations with clubs, leagues and media partners.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on organic and paid amplification.

### **Reporting & Performance**

* Track KPIs: reach, views, watch time, engagement, follower growth, retention and sentiment.
* Deliver weekly/monthly reporting with clear insights and next actions for the team and leadership.
* Run testing frameworks to improve formats, hooks, timing and distribution.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **5+ years** of experience in social media, with at least **2 years coordinating or leading social media teams**.
* Background in **sports journalism, sports media or a sports newsroom** (degree in Journalism or Communications is a plus).
* Proven experience running social channels for **sports media brands, publishers, broadcasters, clubs or leagues**.
* Deep football and sports knowledge, with a strong news sense and love for the game.
* **Excellent English (C1/C2 or native)**: you'll write, edit and approve content in English and it's our main working language. Spanish or other languages are a plus.
* Strong editorial judgement: accuracy, fact-checking, tone and handling sensitive stories.
* Excellent platform instincts across TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube and Facebook, and a good understanding of video-first content.
* Confident using analytics and social listening tools to guide decisions.
* Strong organisation, stakeholder management and the ability to lead a team in a fast-paced, high-output environment.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with live coverage of major tournaments.
* Experience working with audiences in Africa, Latin America or other international markets.
* Hands-on video editing or production experience.

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.

title: Wholesale Assistant
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

As **Wholesale Assistant** , you will support the Wholesale Manager and Account Executives in the daily management of wholesale operations, ensuring clients receive exceptional service and accurate, timely communication throughout the order lifecycle. The role requires strong coordination across internal departments (Commercial, Operations, Logistics, and Finance) and proactive follow-up with external partners.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**  
  
Support the global Wholesale team in day-to-day account Management, assuring that clients are responded to in a timely manner and given the service needed to support their business.

* Oversee wholesale order management from placement to delivery, ensuring accuracy.

* Support sales reporting, data tracking, and client-facing report preparation.
* Maintain client files, communication trackers, and internal communication logs.
* Support with the management of RTV processes, quality issues, and credit notes.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field.
* At least one year of relevant work experience in a similar role.
* Fluency in both Spanish and English is required; additional languages are considered an asset.
* Strong analytical skills, excellent organisational abilities, and effective time management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* Previous experience with fashion or luxury brands is a plus, but not essential.

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**
  
  
Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.
  
  
At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

At Taptap, we are not just shaping the future of advertising technology, we are building it today. Guided by teamwork, respect, and determination, we challenge the status quo, connect ideas with impact, and create innovative solutions that drive real results. Reporting directly to the Programmatic Trading Director, the candidate will play an important role within both the Product Operations & the broader commercial teams. The candidate will proactively manage campaigns booked by the Revenue team – Direct Response, Branding or Tactical, whether sold directly or programmatically, ensuring all booked campaigns not just deliver in volume terms, but also exceed client expectations in terms of KPIs.  
  
The candidate will work very closely and regularly interact with the Revenue & Product teams and through them with all customers, be they agencies and direct clients. The trader will be responsible for maintaining up-to-date forecasts of inventory availability, as well as providing ad hoc and regular reporting and recommendations on site, campaign and ad performance, sell-through and yield.  
  
The candidate will work in close collaboration with the Product and Revenue teams, and act as their interface with Sonata, to ensure that client Media programmatic revenues continue to grow across all Data-Driven Digital Strategies.  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
1. Programming and Implementing Digital Media campaigns:

* Interfacing with agencies, trading desks and direct clients.
* Reviewing and processing advertising campaign material.
* Requiring plan assets, such as creatives and tracking tags.
* Setting up data-driven digital ad campaigns in Sonata.
* Managing bid strategies for campaigns.
* Operating across ad servers, ad technology solutions and Sonata’s DSP & DMP platform.
* Guaranteeing the campaign’s kick-off and deployment.

2. Monitoring the Digital Media campaigns:

* Regularly monitoring and reconciling campaign delivery across third party ad serving systems.
* Analyzing digital inventory to determine what is performing best for sponsors based on click-through rate, viewability, and user engagement, and any other KPIs.
* Following-up on the campaign’s KPIs daily.
* Filling out the daily monitoring forms.
* Troubleshooting any ad creative issues that affect tracking, implementation, or reporting.
* Designing and implementing benchmarks according to performance or quality assurance KPIs.
* Informing the team about alert situations.

3. Optimizing the Digital media campaigns:

* Applying A/B testing on the creative pieces, targeting segments or media plans in order to improve the impact on the distinct audiences meeting campaign goals.
* Analyzing and recommend campaign modifications, leveraging understanding of advertiser and product performance and any improvements to the strategic plan to increase conversion.
* Maximizing performance and ad revenue.

4. Reporting:

* Providing campaign reports to internal teams, using internal and third-party sources as needed.
* Elaborating the results and insights reports for our clients and partners.

* Additional language skills will be considered an advantage.
* 3 years of experience on similar position within a trading desk, publisher, advertiser adops/programmatic team. \*Profiles with less demonstrable digital marketing experience will not be considered\*.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and follow-up process.
* Strong initiative and ability to plan and prioritize work efficiently, multi-task, and work well under pressure with minimal direction.
* Data driven personality, ability to tell stories based on campaign data analysis.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Understanding of on-line and digital advertising metrics and KPIs.

* Experience with analytics or BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Google Analytics.
* HTML/Javascript knowledge.
* Advanced spreadsheet capabilities.

* Strong possibilities of internal promotion in an international firm.
* Competitive compensation package, according with the candidate´s profile & experience.
* Attractive benefits package
* Great working environment.

title: Regional Marketing Manager - Europe
description:
**About Camlin**

Camlin is a global technology leader that operates with the vision of bringing revolutionary products to life for a wide range of industries, including power and rail, and also has interests in a number of R&D projects in a variety of scientific sectors.

At Camlin we believe in high quality engineering and design, allowing us to develop market leading products and services. In short, we love creating value for our customers by solving difficult problems. As of now, Camlin operates in over 20 countries worldwide.

**Regional Marketing Manager, Europe**

**Department:** Marketing  
**Reports To:** Head of Regional Marketing  
**Travel:** Up to 30%

**Overview**

Camlin Energy is seeking a commercially focused Regional Marketing Manager to lead marketing execution across Europe. This role is responsible for developing and delivering regional marketing plans that create demand, support strategic account growth, strengthen customer relationships and contribute directly to revenue and pipeline objectives.

Working closely with regional sales teams, product specialists and senior stakeholders, the successful candidate will ensure marketing activity is aligned with priority markets, customer needs and commercial growth targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regional Marketing Strategy & Execution**

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly marketing plans aligned to regional business objectives.
* Translate global marketing strategies into local market activity.
* Drive integrated campaigns across digital, content, events, ABM and customer engagement programmes.
* Ensure regional marketing activity supports revenue growth, pipeline creation and customer retention.
* Develop regional-specific messaging frameworks to drive a high-quality output of marketing materials and thought-leadership content

**Commercial & Sales Alignment**

* Partner closely with regional sales leadership and account teams.
* Support strategic account growth through targeted customer engagement programmes.
* Develop marketing initiatives that accelerate opportunities through the sales cycle.
* Create customer-focused assets that support commercial conversations and account progression.

**Demand Generation**

* Deliver campaigns that generate qualified leads and measurable pipeline impact.
* Work with demand generation and digital specialists to optimise performance across channels.
* Monitor campaign effectiveness and implement continuous improvements.

**Events & Customer Engagement**

* Lead regional event strategy, including industry exhibitions, executive briefings, webinars and customer forums.
* Maximise event ROI through integrated pre-event, onsite and post-event campaigns.
* Build opportunities for customer advocacy and thought leadership.

**Market Intelligence**

* Monitor industry trends, regulatory policies, competitive activity and emerging market opportunities.
* Provide regional insights to support marketing and business planning.
* Identify new growth opportunities within transmission, distribution and critical infrastructure sectors.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work collaboratively with product, sales, engineering and corporate marketing teams.
* Build strong relationships with Siemens Energy marketing counterparts and regional stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment between regional execution and global priorities.

**Requirements**

**Essential**

* 6+ years' experience in B2B marketing.
* Strong content writing skills, with the ability to turn technical product information into creative copy for a range of formats
* Experience supporting complex technical or industrial products and services.
* Proven track record delivering integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of demand generation and pipeline development.
* Experience working with sales teams and supporting strategic accounts through account-based marketing activity.
* Experience within energy, utilities, electrical infrastructure, industrial technology or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Excellent project management and organisational skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of European utility and energy markets.
* Experience operating within a matrix or multinational organisation.
* Additional European language skills.

**Success Measures**

* Contribution to regional pipeline and revenue targets.
* Marketing-sourced and influenced opportunities.
* Strategic account engagement metrics.
* Campaign performance and ROI.
* Lead-to-opportunity conversion performance.
* Growth in customer engagement and brand awareness across priority markets.

**Our Values**

* We work together
* We believe in people
* We won’t accept the ‘way it has always been done’
* We listen to learn
* We’re trying to do the right thing

Individuals seeking employment at Camlin are considered without regards to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital states, ancestry, physical or mental disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

title: Head of Secondary
description:
**About the School - The British School of Barcelona (Castelldefels):**  
The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  
  
BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in three locations, two just outside the city of Barcelona – in Castelldefels, where we have a Primary, Secondary and Pre-University campus, and in the cosmopolitan town of Sitges, where we have another Primary campus. There are two more campuses in Barcelona, located in the heart of the city and featuring a Foundation campus, BSB Esperanza, which offers EY and Year 1 (opened in September 2021), as well as a brand-new main campus, BSB Luca, which offers Primary, Secondary, and Pre-University education and opened in September 2023.
  
  
In September 2026 we opened another campus, initially for EYFS and Primary-aged students, north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area.
  
  
The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of–the art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  
  
Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year-round sunshine.
  
  
The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Head of Secondary** to join our fantastic team.
  
  
**About Cognita:**  
Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 20 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  
  
At Cognita, we know every student is unique. We nurture their distinct personalities and strengths. We support them academically, socially, and emotionally, wherever they are in the world, wherever they’re starting from. And each and every one of our schools is unique too.
  
  
We protect what’s special about them, while offering them rich knowledge, opportunities, and best practices. And they get to be part of something bigger. We open their classrooms to the collective wisdom of over 90 schools in 20 countries, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class.
  
  
It’s an individual approach that empowers every school, teacher and student to focus on what they do best and thrive.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are seeking an exceptional and inspirational leader to join our Senior Leadership Team as Head of Secondary, Castelldefels. This pivotal role is responsible for leading our Secondary School across both the Main Site and Nexus Sixth Form, ensuring outstanding academic achievement, student wellbeing, and personal development for all learners from Years 7 to 13. Working closely with the Executive Principal and senior colleagues, you will drive strategic school improvement, lead and develop high-performing teams, oversee the quality of teaching and learning, and ensure excellence in day-to-day operations. The successful candidate will champion a positive and inclusive school culture, strengthen student recruitment and retention, and play a key role in delivering a holistic educational experience that prepares students for success both in school and beyond.  
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For:**  
We are looking for an outstanding educational leader with significant senior leadership experience and a proven track record of driving academic excellence and sustained school improvement. The successful candidate will be a qualified teacher with a degree and recognised teaching qualification, combining strategic vision with a genuine commitment to student wellbeing, safeguarding, and holistic education. description:
As Director, Commercial Transformation, you will lead the commercial transformation agenda for EMEA-LATAM, translating strategic priorities, growth opportunities, and complex business needs into clear roadmaps, well-governed initiatives, and execution-ready programs. You will orchestrate cross-functional transformation, create alignment around critical decisions and trade-offs, and maintain momentum from initial framing through implementation and adoption.

  

More about the role

* Lead a portfolio of high-impact commercial transformation initiatives across EMEA-LATAM, providing the structure, governance, and cross-functional orchestration needed to turn complex priorities into coordinated action.
* Translate complex business challenges and strategic priorities into clear transformation roadmaps, workstreams, decision points, resource requirements, and implementation approaches.
* Identify, shape, and prioritize transformation opportunities based on business value, feasibility, investment requirements, interdependencies, risks, and organizational readiness.
* Own the Commercial Transformation PMO and its governance framework, including portfolio cadence, milestone tracking, executive reporting, decision preparation, and escalation of risks and issues.
* Mobilize senior, cross-functional stakeholders across regional functions, clusters, and markets; create alignment on outcomes, scope, ownership, resources, trade-offs, and success measures.
* Act as a trusted transformation partner to regional and market leadership, bringing together the relevant functional expertise, surfacing cross-functional implications, and enabling timely decisions and coordinated action.
* Build momentum and organizational readiness for change, ensuring that initiatives are practical, adopted, and embedded rather than remaining at the level of recommendation or design.
* Transition established solutions to Commercial Excellence or the relevant business owner for ongoing scaling, optimization, and long-term ownership.
  

More about you

**Essential qualifications:**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in commercial or enterprise transformation, business leadership, consulting, or program leadership within complex, multi-market organizations.
* Proven success leading complex regional or enterprise-wide transformations from planning and cross-functional mobilization through implementation, adoption, and measurable impact.
* Strong commercial acumen and expertise in transformation planning, portfolio governance, change management, value creation, and execution.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in matrixed environments, align senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity and trade-offs, and translate complex qualitative and quantitative insights into clear decisions and action.
* Strong executive presence, judgment, communication, and facilitation skills, supported by proficiency in project and portfolio management tools, advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills, and openness to responsible use of AI-enabled tools.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with willingness to travel approximately 20–30% across EMEA-LATAM.
  

**Good to have qualifications:**

* Experience in healthcare, medtech, hearing care, or another complex, vertically integrated business environment.
* Prior commercial or sales leadership experience, with a practical understanding of market dynamics, customer-facing execution, and commercial team leadership.

title: AI Development Director
description:
### **About The Role**

This job profile outlines a role that balances solid professional experience, a strategic mindset, and hands-on technical delivery. The successful candidate will combine sound business judgment with the ability to personally evaluate existing AI tools and solutions, frame the right use cases for the business, and quickly implement working developments for the Business Units and Corporate functions. This is a type of hybrid strategy-plus-build profile.

As the AI Development Director, this position plays a pivotal role in **shaping the artificial intelligence agenda** of the company while **personally delivering the solutions** that bring it to life. The role combines **strategic framing of AI opportunities**, evaluation of existing tools and vendor solutions, and **rapid hands-on implementation** of developments requested by the Business Units and Corporate functions. Reporting directly to the Chief Innovation and Strategy Officer, and with the perspective of leading a small team of developers, this role significantly contributes to the organization's innovation roadmap, operational efficiency, and competitive positioning. The primary objectives of this role include:

* **Support the definition of the AI Roadmap**: Lead the development and continuous refinement of the Group’s AI strategy and roadmap, **aligning AI investments with corporate and business priorities**, and presenting progress to the Board of Directors and ExCom
* **Evaluate tools and deliver solutions hands-on**: Assess the AI tools and platforms available in the market and already in use at the Group, select the right approach for each business need, and **personally implement working solutions** — quickly and pragmatically — for the Business Units and Corporate functions, from agriculture and operations to commercial, finance, and HR
* **Develop AI and Technology perspective**: **Track the evolving AI landscape**, critically evaluate emerging models, tools and vendors, benchmark competitor and industry adoption, and translate trends into actionable, prioritized opportunities for the Group
* **Drive AI delivery and governance**: **Own the end-to-end AI delivery cycle** — from use-case identification and feasibility, through data readiness, model development, deployment and scaling — while establishing **responsible-AI, data-privacy, and risk-management standards** across the Group
* **Collaborate with Group’s top Executives and lead a small delivery team**: Partner with the CISO and ExCom stakeholders to **embed AI into business priorities**, working with IT, operations, commercial, marketing, finance, human resources, and Business Units teams to co-design solutions, secure data access, and drive change management for AI adoption. Where needed, lead and mentor a small team of analysts to extend delivery capacity while **remaining personally hands-on with the technical work**

### **About You**

* Ideal candidate has **6-10 years of professional experience** and is currently a Manager or Senior Manager within the **advanced analytics / AI practice of a top-tier strategy consulting firm** — BCG X, McKinsey QuantumBlack, Bain Advanced Analytics, Kearney Digital, or equivalent — with strong analytical capabilities and **proven hands-on AI experience**; candidates from the general strategy practice are not the target profile; complementary time in industry, a technology company, or a hyperscaler / AI-native organization is a plus, as is some experience leading a small team of analysts
* Demonstrated leadership skills: successfully **collaborate with CEO and ExCo members** to set the AI vision, execute assignments and deliver tangible business outcomes
* Strategic thinking paired with strong execution instincts: ability to **frame the problem, choose the right tool, and move from idea to deployed solution** in short cycles, with sound Project / Product management, Change leadership, and Cross-functional collaboration skills
* AI expertise across the full delivery lifecycle — **generative AI / LLMs, classical machine learning, MLOps**, and data engineering foundations — with the ability to evaluate existing tools and vendor solutions, decide **build-vs-buy pragmatically**, and personally take solutions from **prototype to production**
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to adapt to diverse and evolving business needs
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with hands-on technical fluency (**Python, SQL, cloud AI platforms** such as Azure / AWS / GCP) and the ability to develop impactful presentation decks (PowerPoint) for executive audiences
* Proven ability to **work autonomously end-to-end** — from problem framing to deployed solution — with limited supervision and under pressure
* Attention to detail coupled with strategic thinking. **High curiosity and a hunger to learn**

**Location & Travel**

This is a 100% on-site position based at our Madrid offices. The role requires broad flexibility and willingness to travel frequently and internationally, wherever the business needs it.

### **About Us**

**AMFRESH Group** is a global agrifood innovation company shaping the future of FRESH food through innovation, science and technology. Through its vertically integrated business model, the Group combines proprietary genetics and breeding, agriscience, biotechnology, sustainable farming and global commercialization to translate scientific innovation into commercial impact at scale. With more than 95 years of expertise, AMFRESH is privately held, operates in over 60 countries and employs more than 12,000 people worldwide. AMFRESH partners with many of the world's leading retailers and growers to deliver differentiated products, trusted supply and innovation across the FRESH food value chain, helping build healthier, more resilient and more sustainable food systems.

  

For further information, visit www.amfresh.com.

description:
