title: Director of Design
description:
About Mendocino Farms
  
At Mendocino Farms, we do a lot more than just sell sandwiches and salads. We are a fast-casual restaurant brand on a mission to bring people together through fresh, culinary-driven food and unmatched hospitality. As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory across new and existing markets, we are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and hands-on leader to elevate our total rewards structure.
  
Our Core Values and Mantras
  

* Sell Happy: The foundational philosophy that goes beyond serving meals to actively uplifting and improving every guest's day.
* Food Should Make People Feel Good: A commitment to using high-quality, whole, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients that make eating well easy.
* Be Culinary Explorers: A passion for combining fresh ingredients and bold flavors in unexpected, gourmet ways.
* Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.
* Get Better Every Day (GBED): An internal mantra encouraging continuous learning, personal growth, and skill development.

Director of Design
  
  
**Reports To:** VP, Design & Construction
  
**FLSA Status:** Exempt
  
**Cost Center:** 9511
  
**Location:** Dallas, TX or Remote, USA
  
**Salary Range:** $117,000–$190,000 (Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.)
  
  
Position Summary
  
Mendocino Farms is seeking a Director of Design to lead the evolution and delivery of our restaurant experience across new restaurants, remodels, refreshes, and strategic initiatives.
  
**This leader will own Mendo’s design function:** the restaurant prototype, design standards, internal and external design resources, and the systems that turn brand strategy into distinctive, functional, and scalable restaurants. You will partner closely with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, Real Estate, and Marketing to create environments that strengthen the guest experience while supporting efficient operations, disciplined investment, and growth.
  
This is an opportunity for a creative and operationally minded leader who can set a compelling design point of view, build a high-performing team and consultant network, and make practical decisions that balance quality, durability, speed, cost, and long-term unit performance as Mendocino Farms expands its restaurant footprint.
  
Core Responsibilities
  
Lead the Design Function
  

* Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop internal designers and external design resources; set clear expectations, effective working rhythms, and a high bar for quality and accountability.
* Resource Alignment: Align internal and external design resources to the development pipeline, identifying when specialized expertise is needed.
* Senior Design Leadership: Serve as the senior design leader for complex, high-visibility, or high-risk projects and decisions.

Own the Brand Environment and Design Standards
  

* Prototype & Standards Ownership: Own and evolve Mendo’s restaurant prototype, design standards, material palettes, finishes, furniture, fixtures, lighting, equipment integration, and reusable design details.
* Brand Consistency: Ensure every restaurant delivers a recognizable Mendo experience while adapting appropriately to site conditions, market needs, and business priorities.
* Brand Evolution: Use operating feedback, field learning, and market insight to keep the brand environment relevant, differentiated, and scalable.
* Creative Point of View: Set and elevate Mendo’s creative design point of view, translating brand strategy into memorable, functional restaurant environments that feel distinctive across markets and formats.

Improve Restaurant Operations Through Design
  

* Operational Design Standards: Maintain and evolve design standards that prioritize guest flow, ordering and pickup, digital and delivery activity, seating, accessibility, storage, serviceability, and day-to-day operations.
* Kitchen & BOH Planning: Partner with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, and equipment vendors to improve kitchen planning, back-of-house flow, equipment integration, team ergonomics, throughput, food safety, and maintainability.
* Post-Opening Learning: Incorporate post-opening learning into future layouts, prototypes, and specifications.

Drive Quality, Clarity, and Design Delivery
  

* Design Delivery: Oversee design delivery for new restaurants, remodels, and refresh programs from feasibility test fits and concepts through permit-ready documentation and design-related construction support.
* QA/QC & Phase Gates: Establish practical design QA/QC and phase-gate practices that produce complete, coordinated, code-aware, and timely deliverables.
* Cross-Functional Reviews: Lead cross-functional reviews using clear agendas, advance pre-reads, recommendations, concise decision requests, and thoroughly documented follow-through.
* Stakeholder Direction: Translate stakeholder input into clear direction for internal teams and consultants, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early.
* Constructability: Partner with Construction to protect design intent, improve constructability, and reduce design-related rework, RFIs, and change orders.

Manage Partners and Investment Decisions
  

* Partner Management: Select, brief, manage, and evaluate architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors; set clear expectations for scope, quality, timing, communication, and accountability.
* Value Engineering: Partner with Construction and Real Estate to understand design cost drivers and make value-engineering recommendations.
* Investment Tradeoffs: Balance brand expression, operating performance, durability, cost, schedule, and long-term unit economics in design and specification decisions.
* Performance Tracking: Track design-function performance, capacity, risks, and priorities; use post-project reviews to improve standards, tools, and partner performance.
* Annual Operating Plan: Develop the annual design operating plan in partnership with Real Estate, including internal and consultant capacity, priorities, budget needs, and key risks; provide regular updates on design delivery.

Leadership Competencies
  

* Ownership & Accountability: Sets clear expectations, follows through reliably, and maintains a high bar for quality.
* People Development & Coaching: Builds the capabilities of internal team members and external partners.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Creates alignment across Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, Real Estate, Marketing, and vendors.
* Creative & Operational Judgment: Balances brand expression with functionality, durability, speed, cost, and unit performance.
* Continuous Improvement: Uses field learning, post-project reviews, and market insight to strengthen standards and systems.
* Clear Decision-Making: Communicates concise recommendations, surfaces risks and tradeoffs, and documents follow-through.
* Strategic Execution: Translates brand strategy into scalable prototypes, standards, plans, and restaurant environments.

Qualifications, Education & Experience
  
  
**Required:**  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Environmental Design, Product Design, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in restaurant, retail, hospitality, architecture, interior design, or another related built-environment discipline.
* Leadership: Experience leading a design team, studio, function, or substantial network of external design partners in a fast-moving, multi-project environment.
* Industry Footprint: Significant hands-on experience with restaurant or similarly operationally intensive commercial design, including prototype development, new-unit growth, remodels, and site-specific adaptation.
* Operational Design: Strong command of FOH/BOH flow, kitchen equipment, labor and ergonomics, guest circulation and accessibility, pickup and delivery, food safety, storage, and maintainability.
* Partner Management: Experience managing architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors against quality, schedule, scope, and budget expectations.
* Technical Knowledge: Working knowledge of construction documentation, design QA/QC, permitting, building and health codes, design detailing, accessibility, shop-drawing review, and constructability.
* Financial Acumen: Fluency with design budgets, cost drivers, value engineering, specification tradeoffs, lifecycle durability, and unit economics.
* Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including concise recommendations and executive-ready presentations.
* Travel: Ability to travel occasionally for market visits, project milestones, and team meetings.

**Preferred:**  

* Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu, Excel, PowerPoint, and project-management platforms.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or Revit and SketchUp.
* Experience scaling design infrastructure during periods of rapid restaurant growth.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS INCLUDE
  

* Competitive Salary, Bonus, and Equity
* Unlimited Meal Privileges
* Health Care & Wellness Benefits
* HSA/FSA
* Pet Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Commuter Benefits
* 401(k) Plan with Company Match

* Note: Benefit offerings may differ based on region, position, and employment type.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  

* Must be able to lift 25 pounds.
* Ability to sit or stand for 6–8 hours.
* Hand use includes single grasping, fine manipulation, pushing, and pulling.
* Work requires bending, twisting, squatting, and reaching.

All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Director of Learning Design
description:
**About Tergar Schools**

Tergar Schools is a Buddhist-inspired K–12 education nonprofit building a new model of learning (MOL). We operate a pilot school in Kathmandu, Nepal, and are constructing a larger campus in the Yolmo Valley in the Himalayas.

Our model rests on a simple starting point: every child possesses basic goodness and its qualities of awareness, love, compassion, wisdom, and joy. It is our job as educators to help them recognize this and give them tools to sustain it. Our long-term aspiration is to help form people who are resilient, altruistic, and joyful.

We’re now building the next chapter of that work: a comprehensive, fully secular model designed to weave into any school’s existing life — not just our own campuses. Rather than build more schools ourselves, we intend to reach 100+ schools in 4+ countries within five years by helping other schools, secular or religious, adopt the model as their own.

**Why This Role Exists**

Our footprint is growing quickly. Two high-performing private schools will begin piloting our model of learning in 2027. A research lab opens in Nepal with a world-class science team. The interest is real and growing.

What we don’t have yet is a full-time position for building the model itself — the products, courses, training materials, and classroom materials that will constitute MOL — and for leading the team that builds it out.

Today that thinking lives mostly with our Executive Director and the instincts of our founding team. This isn’t sustainable at scale. We need someone who can be fully dedicated to this element of our project: an outside-the-box thinker with real contemplative experience, genuinely excited by the challenge of building an entire family of products from scratch rather than adapting an existing portfolio.

**The Opportunity**

This is a builder’s role. You will not inherit a finished product, a proven training program, or a team. You will build those things — starting hands-on, in the room, with our first two outside partner schools — and then lead the team that takes them to scale.

We have materials. However, none of them is a comprehensive, fully secular contemplative model designed to weave into everything a school already does. That is what you would be building, and there is no template for it.

If you are energized by deciding who you need around you rather than inheriting an org chart, and comfortable being personally in the work now so that later you can hand it to people you have trained this is the position for you. .

**What You’ll Own**

**Building the model**

* Design the teacher training program at the center of the MOL — the core product.
* Build out the materials that make the training usable in a real school. Today we imagine adaptable toolkits fitted by hand to each school, a playbook for staff and administrators, and family-facing materials. That is a starting hypothesis, not a spec — the process of choosing what comes is yours to lead.
* Run the model as a product, not a document. Form real hypotheses about what teachers and schools need, test them in live classrooms, and let what you learn change what gets built.
* Propose what gets built now and what waits — and defend those calls. We hold two commitments at once: build lean, and be the best in the world at this. We call it *Minimum Viable Mastery*. You are the person who makes that real week to week, not just in principle.

**Nailing the first schools**

* Be personally hands-on with our new partner schools in Nepal as they begin onboarding in 2027. You will do this work in tandem with the Executive Director (ED).
* Use what you learn there to define what a stable first phase actually looks like, and build the real template other schools will follow.

**Building your team**

* Decide what team you need, and in what order — a Nepal Country Director and Trainer, Country Coordinators, strategic consultants, instructional designers, a UX researcher, and others as the shape of the work becomes clear (a Head of Training in Nepal is currently being hired).
* The ED and the Director of Operations (DOO) authorize and execute the actual hiring. The judgment about who and when is yours.

**Setting the standard, over time**

* Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche and the ED hold final say on model fidelity today. As you build a track record — likely marked by a completed first onboarding cycle with our two partner schools — that authority shifts substantively to you.
* Turn Rinpoche’s two to four multi-day sessions a year into material the team can use again: recorded, distilled, built into training, rather than a remarkable conversation nobody can revisit.

**Working with the evidence**

* Partner with the research lab opening in Nepal in late 2026 — led by Drs. Richard Davidson, Robert Roeser, and Robin Nusslock — translating what they learn into real product and training decisions.

  

**What’s Yours, and What Isn’t**

You own the model and the team you build around you. Three things sit outside that:

* **Fundraising and donor relationships.** A separate role entirely.
* **In-country adaptation and community relationships.** Local teams own this on the ground, but you liaise with them directly and are in very frequent communication.
* **Hiring mechanics.** You decide who you need and when; the DOO handles offers, contracts, and process.

One thing sits in between: **production**. Instructional designers, visual designers, and media support will eventually build finished materials from your direction. You will not be making them yourself for long — but their quality is still on you.

**Who You Are**

**What we’re really looking for**

* **A builder grounded in pedagogy.** Deep pedagogical expertise is essential — you understand how children and adults actually learn, and you've designed for it. What sets you apart is that you build and deliver: you've turned that expertise into programs, curricula, or training that real teachers use. A tech or startup background alongside that is a genuine asset.
* **Fluency in a lean approach to product design.** You can talk concretely about strategic experiments, problem/solution and product/market fit, and validated learning — and you have actually worked that way, not just read about it.
* **Real, lived contemplative experience.** A genuine taste of practice, not necessarily in Tergar’s own lineage, and not merely theoretical familiarity. This is the one non-negotiable that doesn’t bend for the right resume.
* **Comfortable being hands-on first and stepping back later.** Personally in the work with our first schools, then deliberately building the standards and training that let a team carry it without you in the room.
* **Able to build lean and aim to be the best in the world at the same time,** without treating those as a trade-off.

**Experience**

* You bring substantial experience in education — as a teacher, school leader, curriculum developer, or learning designer — and you've built something real from that experience and gotten it into people's hands without much money or staff.
* Some experience directing, mentoring, or building a team from scratch, since you will be doing exactly that here.
* Comfort working directly from a founder’s evolving vision rather than a finished brief — you will be co-writing the brief as you go, especially in the first months.

**Personal qualities**

* Discernment above all: knowing which calls are yours to make outright and which need to go to the Rinpoche or the ED. This carries more weight here than almost any other quality, because for a long stretch there is no layer of management between your judgment and the model’s integrity.
* Genuine curiosity about and respect for a tradition that may not be your own, without needing to adopt it as your own practice.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a mandate that will keep changing shape under you as the first schools teach you things no one currently knows.

  

**How We Work Together**

* Intensive, hands-on time in Nepal during onboarding and the first deployment of the model. Expect three to five months during the first year.
* Frequent, close contact with the ED for the first six months, settling into a slower rhythm as trust builds.
* Two to four multi-day sessions a year with Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche, alongside the wider team.
* A small, distributed, high-autonomy culture across Vermont, Wisconsin, Ireland, Kathmandu, and Minnesota — deep, steady, skillful work over speed.

  

**Compensation & Logistics**

* Full-time
* Fully remote.
* Compensation: $75,000–$100,000, DOE
* Benefits: flexible schedule, unlimited PTO, and health care reimbursement up to $1,000 per month

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Associate Director, Prior Authorization Operations leads a high-volume pharmacy prior authorization operation, setting direction for a team of leaders and a 100+ clinician and technician workforce. This role owns operational, quality, compliance, and financial performance and drives innovation and process improvement across the end-to-end prior authorization process. Partnering with Clinical Services, Client Services, Compliance, and Technology, this leader connects daily operations to enterprise strategy and helps enable technology solutions that improve the member, provider, and client experience. This is an opportunity for an aspiring leader ready to make a visible impact and grow toward broader leadership roles at OptumRx.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

* Lead 5+ direct reports and 100+ indirect pharmacists and technicians; coach, develop, and build a bench of future leaders
* Own end-to-end performance, including turnaround time, quality, productivity, service, and regulatory and contractual guarantees, through real-time inventory and queue management
* Partner with department leadership on volume forecasting, capacity and staffing plans, and budget management
* Drive innovation and continuous process improvement across the prior authorization process, to improve outcomes
* Partner with Technology and Product teams to define requirements, pilot and scale solution; lead change management and adoption across teams
* Serve as the clinical and operational escalation point for complex cases; represent PA Operations with Clinical Services, Client Services, Compliance, and in client meetings
* Maintain audit readiness and compliance with CMS, state, accreditation, and client requirements; monitor quality and safety trends and drive measurable action plans

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

* Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or B.S. Pharmacy with an active, unrestricted pharmacist license, and:

* In-depth clinical knowledge of disease states, pharmacotherapy, and current treatment guidelines, including specialty and high-cost therapies
* Ability to interpret complex clinical scenarios and apply medical necessity criteria, FDA labeling, and compendia to coverage decisions
* Proven record of delivering measurable improvements in turnaround time, quality, productivity, or cost in a regulated environment
* Demonstrated experience leading process improvement or technology-enabled initiatives from concept through measurable outcomes
* Solid executive communication skills, with the ability to turn clinical, operational, and data insights into clear recommendations for leaders and clients
* Solid data fluency with Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook; working proficiency with Microsoft Copilot or other company-approved AI tools
* Ability to work flexible hours between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM, including weekends as business needs require

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or project management certification; MBA, MHA, or managed care residency
* 1+ year of client-facing experience presenting performance results and improvement plans
* PBM or managed care experience operationalizing clinical guidelines, formulary, and benefit design across Medicare Part D, Commercial, and/or Medicaid
* Hands-on experience deploying workflow automation or AI solutions in a clinical or operational setting
* Financial acumen, including building business cases and quantifying ROI, cost-to-operate, and capacity impact

title: Director, Editorial and Engagement
description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a global nonprofit organization working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalyzing the rapid development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. With 30 years of internationally recognized expertise on climate policy and a fierce commitment to exploring all potential solutions, CATF is a pragmatic, non-ideological advocacy group with the bold ideas needed to address climate change. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington, D.C., and Brussels, with staff working virtually around the world.

**What You'll Do**
==================

CATF works to accelerate the solutions needed to achieve a zero-emissions future. As a senior leader within the Communications & Marketing team, you will shape how CATF tells its story, elevates its ideas and experts, and engages the audiences that can help turn climate and energy solutions into real-world impact.

You will bring together institutional storytelling, executive communications, strategic events, media relations, and other important communications opportunities. Working across CATF, you will help determine which stories we tell, where and how we show up, and how our communications support organizational priorities.

This role will build an integrated editorial and engagement strategy that connects CATF's expertise with policymakers, industry leaders, donors, media, and other influential audiences.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Editorial Strategy & Institutional Storytelling** – Develop and carry out CATF's organization-wide editorial strategy and content calendar, turning organizational priorities and technical expertise into clear, compelling stories for priority audiences.
* **Messaging, Voice & Editorial Standards** – Maintain CATF's organizational messaging, editorial standards, voice, and style guidance so communications are accurate, accessible, consistent, and aligned with CATF's brand.
* **Flagship Content Leadership** – Lead or guide major institutional content, including CATF's annual report, organizational and program milestones, impact case studies, and other high-profile content.
* **Strategic Events & External Engagement** – Develop an organization-wide approach to priority events and engagements, including conferences, climate weeks, convenings, speaking opportunities, roundtables, executive engagements, and CATF-led events. Help determine the audience, messaging, speakers, content, and communications strategy for each opportunity.
* **Executive Communications & Thought Leadership** – Develop communications strategies for CATF executives and senior experts. Identify opportunities and produce speeches, opinion pieces, commentary, presentations, talking points, and other executive communications.
* **Media Relations & Reputation Building** – Work with Communications & Marketing colleagues to build relationships with influential journalists and outlets, elevate CATF's experts, and provide communications counsel during major media moments and sensitive or reputational issues.
* **Integrated Content & Engagement Planning** – Connect CATF's editorial, media, executive communications, and event strategies through an integrated planning process tied to organizational priorities and audience needs.
* **People Leadership & Team Development** – Supervise, coach, and develop communications staff. Set clear priorities and standards while supporting independent judgment, collaboration, and professional growth.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

You are an experienced communications leader, writer, editor, convener, and strategist who understands how strong ideas become useful stories, conversations, and engagements. You can make complex climate, energy, technical, and policy issues clear without losing important context.

You bring sound editorial judgment and a collaborative leadership style. You can advise senior leaders, develop staff, and build alignment across functions, cultures, geographies, and time zones.

### **Required Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* 10–15 years of progressively responsible experience in strategic communications, editorial leadership, media relations, journalism, public affairs, external engagement, or a related field.
* Strong English-language writing, editing, and storytelling skills, including experience translating complex technical or policy issues into clear communications.
* Demonstrated expertise in editorial strategy, institutional storytelling, organizational messaging, and high-profile content.
* Significant experience developing executive communications and thought leadership, including speeches, opinion pieces, commentary, presentations, talking points, or other executive-level content.
* Experience developing proactive media relations strategies, working directly with journalists and editors, and advising on sensitive, rapid-response, or reputational communications.
* Experience developing strategic events and external engagements, including conferences, convenings, executive engagements, speaking opportunities, or similar forums.
* People leadership and cross-functional collaboration experience, including supervising and developing staff, advising senior leaders, and working with technical experts, policy professionals, development teams, and communications colleagues.

### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience with climate and energy policy, advocacy, policymaking, environmental policy, clean technology, science, or a closely related field.
* Familiarity with engagement strategies for major international climate, energy, policy, business, or philanthropic forums.
* Experience developing editorial or event content for donors, funders, and other philanthropic audiences.
* Experience working in a global or geographically distributed organization.
* Experience in a nonprofit, think tank, research institution, philanthropic organization, government, journalism, or a similarly mission-driven environment.
* Additional language skills.

**What We Provide**
===================

Join a team working to accelerate climate solutions while improving how CATF shares its work and engages the audiences that can help move it forward.

* A mission-driven role shaping how CATF communicates its work and engages influential audiences.
* Opportunities to collaborate with recognized experts and senior leaders on climate, technology, energy, and policy issues.
* Cross-functional work with Communications & Marketing, Development, executive leadership, and CATF's programs and regions.
* A collaborative and intellectually curious culture where diverse perspectives are valued and bold, practical solutions to climate change are encouraged.
* A flexible remote working environment, with a preference for candidates based in the United States and the ability to work effectively across U.S. and European time zones.
* Periodic domestic and international travel for CATF meetings, conferences, strategic events, media opportunities, and other organizational priorities.
* Benefits designed to support health, financial security, time away, and flexibility.

**Compensation & Pay Transparency**

CATF believes candidates should have clear information about compensation and benefits so they can make informed decisions about opportunities with us. Our compensation ranges are based on the country of employment, and employees are paid in the applicable local currency. Any range listed below applies only to the country identified. For candidates working in other approved countries, compensation will be determined using the applicable local range, taking into account relevant market factors, role scope and responsibilities, experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity.

  

The expected base salary range for this position is:

* **United States: $147,137–$176,565 USD annually**

CATF does not consider an applicant's salary history when determining compensation.

**Benefits**

For U.S.-based employees, CATF offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support health, financial security, time away, and flexibility. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, with CATF currently paying 80% of medical premiums and 100% of dental premiums for eligible employees; a 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar employer match of up to 5% of gross annual salary; 25 working days of vacation per year for full-time employees; paid sick leave; U.S. holidays; and one flex day in December. CATF also provides employer-paid basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage, along with home-office setup support, a monthly internet stipend, and additional health, wellness, and voluntary benefit resources. Eligibility, coverage, costs, and plan terms are governed by applicable plan documents.

  

**Ready to Apply?**
===================

If you've made it this far, you should go ahead and apply.

You don't need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role aligns with how you like to work and the kind of impact you want to have, we encourage you to submit your application.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
===============================

Clean Air Task Force is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Retention & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
**About Onnit:**

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. As a trusted and serious supplement brand, we provide high-quality products with clinically studied ingredients designed to unlock a deeper mind-body connection and enhance both mental and physical performance. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

We are part of the Wellbeing Collective, an exciting Global Business Unit within Unilever built with a start-up mindset. Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

**JOB SUMMARY**

We're looking for an analytical, hands-on lifecycle marketer to own email, SMS, and customer retention, with a particular focus on subscription growth and churn reduction. You'll execute the strategy and work in Klaviyo, from creating content blocks and building campaigns to launching flows, refining segments, and analyzing results. Use customer behavior, cohort performance, and lifetime value insights to decide what to send, to whom, and when.

This role combines strategic ownership with end-to-end execution. You're someone who enjoys being "in the weeds", turning ideas into live campaigns, managing day-to-day production, and using results to shape your next move. This is an opportunity to own the full lifecycle marketing process and see the impact of your work on customer relationships and business growth.

This role is designed for someone with roughly 5 years of relevant experience who wants meaningful ownership while staying close to the work.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Email and SMS strategy and execution

* Own the email and SMS calendar, balancing promotional campaigns with customer education, replenishment, subscription conversion, and retention messaging.
* Personally build, QA, schedule, and launch campaigns and automated flows in Klaviyo.
* Create, maintain, and manage reusable content blocks and templates; assemble and format messages for launch.
* Build and refine customer segments using purchase behavior, subscription status, engagement, lifecycle stage, and cohort insights.
* Develop and optimize journeys such as welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, subscription onboarding, cancellation prevention, and winback.
* Run practical tests across messaging, offers, creative, timing, frequency, and audience selection, then apply what you learn.
* Maintain strong execution standards across mobile rendering, links, personalization, deliverability, and consent practices.

Subscription Growth and Churn Reduction

* Execute lifecycle marketing initiatives that convert one-time purchasers into subscribers and help existing subscribers stay engaged.
* Identify which customers are most likely to benefit from subscription and develop relevant messages, offers, and conversion journeys.
* Analyze subscription churn, cancellation patterns, and customer behavior to identify opportunities to improve retention.
* Build and test onboarding, education, replenishment, save, and reactivation initiatives that address those opportunities.
* Bring customer insights to product, brand, and customer-experience partners to help strengthen the overall subscriber experience.

Lifecycle Strategy and Practical Analytics

* Develop lifecycle and cohort strategies that reflect how different customers discover, buy, return, subscribe, and lapse.
* Analyze cohort retention, repeat purchase, customer lifetime value (LTV), subscription conversion, and churn to prioritize the highest-impact work.
* Own recurring lifecycle performance reporting, connecting campaign and flow results to broader retention and subscription outcomes.
* Translate analysis into clear recommendations, a prioritized testing plan, and hands-on execution.
* Distinguish channel-attributed results from broader customer trends and use practical testing to assess what is working.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner directly with the Director of E-commerce and Retention on broader retention strategy, priorities, and performance reviews.
* Coordinate with creative, product, customer experience, and acquisition partners as needed to keep lifecycle messaging accurate and relevant.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5 + years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, retention, or email/SMS marketing, ideally for CPG subscription business.
* Strong, recent, hands-on Klaviyo experience: you can independently build campaigns and flows, manage content blocks, create segments, run tests, and report on performance.
* Basic HTML/CSS email skills for template edits and troubleshooting.
* Experience improving repeat purchase, subscription conversion, subscriber retention, or churn, with concrete examples of work you personally executed.
* Practical analytical skills: you're comfortable using spreadsheets and platform reporting to understand cohort, LTV, and churn data and turn those insights into marketing decisions.

**Benefits**

* Full medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Basic Life Insurance
* Immediate 401(k) eligibility with company matching
* Unlimited vacation
* Paid holidays
* Flexible workplace policy
* $100/month flexible benefit stipend
* Tuition reimbursement
* Fringe benefits include in-office meals, product credits and discounts, lifestyle spending account, family planning, online learning, fitness stipend, among many others

title: Digital Asset Specialist Consultant
description:
**Independent Contractor:** Digital Asset Specialist Consultant

**Location:** Remote/Virtual

**Project Lead:** Associate Director, Communications

**Position Type:** Independent Contractor, up to 25 hours per week

**Hourly range:** $25-$35 per hour

  

**About Blue Star Families**

Blue Star Families (BSF) is a national nonprofit dedicated to supporting military families by providing programming and resources while strengthening their connections to their local communities. We partner with businesses, government agencies, and local organizations to create impactful programs that empower and uplift military families.

Independent Contractor Engagement Terms:

This independent contractor will be retained solely for project-based, outcome-driven services and will not be an employee, agent, or representative of Blue Star Families. The independent contractor:

* Retains full autonomy over the method, schedule, and tools used to perform services.
* Is not assigned work hours, or internal recurring meetings.
* Shall not use a BSF job title, business card, or name tag.
* Will not represent themselves as a BSF employee or agent to external stakeholders.

  

**Scope of Work & Key Responsibilities**

The Contractor shall perform digital asset management services across the following core functional areas:

**3.1 Canto Platform Governance & Administration**

* Maintain overall organization and structure of the Canto library
* Ensure consistent metadata, tagging conventions, and folder hierarchy

**3.2 Portal Architecture & Intake Workflows**

* Build and manage upload links and portals for national and chapter-level use
* Customize portals to ensure ease of use and alignment with submission guidelines
* Provide guidance or documentation to internal users on proper upload procedures
* Upload assets as needed

**3.3 Quality Assurance & Asset Review**

* Review incoming photo submissions for quality, relevance, and compliance
* Approve or reject assets based on established criteria
* Ensure all images meet brand and privacy standards

**3.4 Compliance, Privacy & Content Scrubbing**

* Review images for sensitive or restricted information, including visible nametapes or identifying details
* Edit, flag, or route assets as needed to ensure compliance with organizational and military guidelines

**3.5 Legacy Asset Audit & System Normalization**

* Work backward through existing asset libraries to:
* + Tag and categorize legacy content
  + Eliminate duplicates or outdated files
  + Reorganize assets into a standardized, searchable system
* Prioritize high-value or frequently used content for faster accessibility

**3.6 Continuous Improvement & Advisory**

* Recommend best practices for digital asset management
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, searchability, and user experience
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align asset organization with programmatic needs

* **Deliverables & Milestones**

* **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs):** Documentation of Canto tagging, taxonomy rules, and upload workflows for internal staff.
* **Custom Intake Portals:** Fully configured upload links/portals tailored for national and chapter-level content submissions.
* **Legacy Library Migration Plan:** Audit report and completed cleanup of historical media files, including deduplication and re-tagging.
* **Monthly Asset Governance Reports:** Regular updates summarizing asset intake volume, approval metrics, and platform optimization efforts.

title: Director, Integrated Marketing

title: Vice President Human Resources
description:
ePac Flexible Packaging is a fast growing global flexible packaging company with locations around the world. Built on breakthrough digital technologies, ePac is at the crossroads of advanced technology and manufacturing. ePac was founded in 2016 with a focus on helping small and medium sized brands compete with great packaging, and today serves thousands of brands of all sizes. In all corners of the world where ePac operates, the company strives to serve the communities in which we reside and contribute to the creation of a more sustainable, circular economy.

https://epacflexibles.com/

***Salary range is up to $250k, + Bonus***

### **SUMMARY OF POSITION**

The VP of Human Resources is an executive operator responsible for scaling ePac’s workforce across 12 manufacturing sites in the U.S. and Canada, as well as a fully remote workforce for Holdings company functions (including Sales, Sales Support, Prepress, IT, Marketing, Finance, HR, Software Engineering, Supply Chain, and Logistics). We are currently in a high-speed growth phase - to grow headcount by 15% over the next year while executing a complex geographic footprint shift.

We do not need an administrator; we need a high-velocity HR leader who can execute the human side of site transitions without adding bureaucracy. You will be expected to move the department from a reactive state to a proactive partner that empowers our Plant Directors with the tools they need to run their businesses.

**STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP & EXECUTION**

* **Site Expansion Management:** Directly lead the HR execution for site expansions (Phoenix/Philly). This requires a playbook for rapid high-volume hiring in new markets while.
* **Anti-Bureaucracy Advocacy:** Actively dismantle over-engineered HR processes. Your goal is to simplify workflows- from hiring to performance reviews-to empower managers rather than burden them with corporate overhead.
* **Talent Velocity & Modern Workforce:** Build and run a proactive recruiting engine while remaining tech-forward. Maintain a deep understanding of the evolving AI landscape, including AI-assisted roles and positions transitioning to AI, to optimize workforce structure and reduce time-to-fill for key roles to under 4 weeks.
* **Cultural Stewardship:** Ensure ePac’s unique, entrepreneurial culture remains intact across a distributed workforce. You must translate the company vision into daily behaviors that drive employee engagement and customer loyalty.
* **Career Architecture:** Design and build comprehensive, transparent career pathways and growth maps for every employee across all departments and levels within the organization.

### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Manager Enablement & Support**

* **Direct Coaching:** Serve as the primary coach for Plant Directors. Provide the actual SOPs, templates, and scripts needed for hiring, coaching, and exiting employees so they can focus on production.
* **Accountability Systems:** Re-launch and enforce the quarterly performance calibration process. Ensure it is a tool for manager-to-employee engagement, not a "check-the-box" administrative task.
* **Leadership Pipeline:** Conduct 9-box assessments to identify "ready-now" and "ready-future" successors for critical roles across all sites.
* **Multi-Department Onboarding & Training:** Build structured onboarding and continuous training programs tailored to both plant-level workers and remote holdings roles (Sales, Sales Support, Prepress, IT, Marketing, Finance, HR, Software Engineering, and Supply Chain/Logistics).

**Data Accountability & Infrastructure**

* **HR Tech & Automation:** Fully leverage existing HR technology platforms (such as Rippling) beyond workforce analytics—driving process automation, operational efficiency, and seamless self-service experiences across all sites and remote teams.
* **Metric-Driven Decision Making:** Track and share core KPIs-Revenue per Employee, Turnover Cost, and Employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS)-to flag risks and growth opportunities in real-time.

**North American Compliance & Operations**

* **Multi-Jurisdictional Expertise:** Own HR and payroll compliance across 11 U.S. sites and 3 Canadian sites You must be an expert in the differing labor laws between U.S. states and Canadian provinces (e.g., Texas vs. Ontario).
* **Labor Relations:** Maintain positive, professional relationships with labor unions where applicable, ensuring all disputes are resolved fairly and in alignment with organization goals
* **Safety & Wellbeing:** Collaborate with Operations and Safety to implement digital wellness platforms that reduce workplace injuries and lower absenteeism.

### **JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

* **Operator Mindset:** Proven ability to manage complex changes in the plant footprint gem
* **High-Volume Talent Strategy:** Experience building a recruitment engine that can scale by 20%+ annually
* **Technical Proficiency:** Advanced knowledge of Rippling or similar tier-one HRIS/payroll platforms with a heavy emphasis on data analytics
* **Communication:** Ability to influence stakeholders from the plant floor to the boardroom.
* **Relatable Engagement:** Demonstrated ability to connect with, support, and advocate for employees at every level of the company, with a strong commitment to plant-level workers on the manufacturing floor.
* **Compliance Mastery:** In-depth knowledge of Federal, State, Provincial (Canada), and local employment laws.

### **EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION**

* **Experience:** Minimum 10+ years of HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a multi-site manufacturing environment.
* **Geographic Scope:** Documented experience managing HR/payroll for a distributed workforce in both the United States and Canada.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or related field required.
* **Travel:** Up to 30% to support site transitions and plant visits.

ePac is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. EEO Poster

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
200,000 - 250,000 USD per year(Remote)

description:

title: Social Media Manager
description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Within our Teacher Education Ecosystem, including Moreland University, we connect with aspiring and current educators, alumni, and school leaders to support their professional journeys. Social media helps us build authentic relationships with these audiences and connect them with valuable resources and opportunities.

**Before you apply...please read this!**

This position is intended for experienced social media marketing professionals who have successfully managed and grown social media accounts for businesses or organizations. **We are not seeking influencers or UGC only content creators whose primary experience is managing personal social media accounts.** A professional social media portfolio is required to be considered for this position. Your portfolio must showcase actual social media work created or managed for businesses or organizations, ideally including measurable results. Personal Instagram, TikTok, or LinkedIn profiles do not qualify as professional portfolios. Applications submitted without a professional social media portfolio will not be considered. IF this fits you, please carry on!!

**Come Build What’s Next**

We’re looking for a Social Media Managerto lead and grow the organic social media presence of Colibri Group’s Teacher Education Ecosystem. This person will shape how our brands show up across social channels, bring educator-focused stories and campaigns to life, build engaged communities, and use performance insights to support awareness, qualified traffic, leads, and applications.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with meaningful ownership of social strategy, day-to-day content production, community engagement, social measurement, and the management of our existing influencer program. As a general guide, approximately 50% of the role is content creation, 25% is social strategy, and 25% spans analytics, reporting, and influencer-program work. The balance will shift with campaigns and business priorities.

We’re looking for someone who has managed social media on behalf of a company, organization, or agency client and understands what it means to collaborate with a marketing team and be accountable for KPIs. You should be equally comfortable developing a channel plan, filming and editing a short-form video, speaking on camera, tailoring content for different audiences, engaging with followers, and explaining what the performance data says to do next.

**Important distinction:** This is a professional social media management position, **not an influencer, brand ambassador, or personal-content-creator opportunity**. You will manage Moreland University's owned social channels and work with external influencers as partners; you will not be hired to promote our brands primarily through your own personal accounts.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Own organic social strategy and editorial planning:** Build audience-specific strategies and content calendars across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging channels. Prioritize Instagram and TikTok for educator audiences, tailor LinkedIn content for school leaders and alumni, and explore authentic, non-promotional participation in relevant Reddit communities. Translate wider Marketing initiatives into platform-native campaigns
* **Create content hands-on, with a strong emphasis on short-form video:** Personally concept, script, film, edit, caption, and publish videos; appear confidently in talking-head content and social live events. Independently produce graphics, carousels, stories, and copy using tools such as Canva, collaborate with the Graphic Designer on brand consistency, and develop social assets to promote guides, events, and podcasts (without hosting the podcast)
* **Build and serve engaged communities:** Manage organic social accounts day to day, including comments, DMs, tags, audience conversations, and admissions-related questions that need routing to the appropriate team. Proactively identify educator and school-leader stories and opportunities for meaningful engagement, not merely one-way posting
* **Measure performance and continually improve results:** Monitor audience growth, reach, engagement, video performance, website traffic, leads, guide downloads, and applications attributable to organic social. Use reporting, experiments, and audience insights to refine creative decisions and channel priorities; demonstrate how social contributes to integrated marketing goals
* **Manage influencer partnerships and collaborate across Marketing:** Oversee existing external creators, including briefs, content review, approvals, deliverables, renewals, payment coordination, budgets, and ROI. Recommend when to expand, adjust, or pause partnerships. Partner closely with content, design, and paid media colleagues; direct management of paid advertising is not part of this position. Occasionally support events and content opportunities requiring travel

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Professional organizational social media experience:** Approximately 2–4 years managing organic social accounts for an employer, organization, or agency client, with personal ownership of deliverables and accountability for KPIs. Managing only your own personal influencer accounts does not meet this requirement; additional relevant professional experience is welcome
* **Proven creation and on-camera skills:** Direct experience independently planning, filming, editing, and publishing compelling short-form video for a brand, plus the ability to appear on camera and support live social content. Strong social copywriting and hands-on Canva, Capcut, or comparable design skills are also expected
* **Demonstrated growth and analytical judgment:** Evidence that you have grown audiences, not solely maintained existing accounts; ability to explain the KPIs you owned, results you achieved, and changes you made based on data. Familiarity with engagement, website traffic, lead or application attribution, and testing is valuable
* **Audience-focused collaboration and execution:** Experience adapting tone, formats, and channels for distinct audiences; engaging communities through comments and DMs; and working within a marketing team to manage a busy editorial calendar, multiple priorities, and cross-functional projects
* **Required professional portfolio:** Include an accessible portfolio link or relevant work samples showing organizational/client accounts, short-form videos you personally produced, and ideally measurable outcomes. Redacted or anonymized case studies are welcome for confidential work. Education/edtech experience, previous influencer-program coordination, Reddit knowledge, a related bachelor's degree, and familiarity with tools such as Sprout Social or ClickUp are helpful but not required. Occasional travel may be necessary

**Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use**

Experience with every tool below is not required. We care more about your ability to create strong work, manage the process, and make decisions from results than about checking specific software boxes.

* **Social channels:** Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and Reddit or other educator communities
* **Video creation:** CapCut or comparable filming and editing workflows. The team is open to effective tools you already know and use
* **Design and production:** Canva, Capcut, and brand templates or design review with an in-house Graphic Designer
* **Scheduling, analytics, and collaboration:** Sprout Social or comparable social management and native analytics tools; ClickUp or similar project-management platforms
* **Measurement and improvement:** Reporting dashboards, campaign tracking, tests, performance reviews, and thoughtful use of AI for ideation, research, repurposing, or productivity while maintaining originality and brand standards

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Own the organic social presence of a mission-driven education ecosystem and shape how our brands show up online
* Create original, video-first content and tell relevant stories for teachers, future educators, alumni, and school leaders
* Grow priority channels such as Instagram and TikTok while testing thoughtful community opportunities, including Reddit
* Collaborate with content, design, and marketing colleagues while retaining autonomy over day-to-day creative execution
* Connect creative work to measurable engagement, leads, and applications while helping evolve an established influencer-partnership program

**What This Role Is NOT**

We want to be transparent about what this opportunity entails so candidates can determine whether it's the right fit for their experience and career goals.

* **This is not an influencer or UGC-only creator position.** We are not hiring someone to promote our brands through their personal social media accounts or primarily create sponsored content. Experience managing professional business or organizational social media accounts is required
* **This is not solely a content creation or graphic design role.** While creativity and hands-on video production are essential, this position also requires organic social strategy, audience development, performance analysis, and measurable results
* **This is not a role focused on directing others to create content.** You will personally develop, film, edit, and publish short-form videos, appear on camera, and manage day-to-day social media activities
* **This is not a paid social advertising position.** Our paid media team manages advertising campaigns. This position focuses on growing and engaging audiences organically while supporting broader marketing goals

We're looking for someone who combines creativity, professional social media management experience, strategic thinking, and a proven ability to grow an organization's social presence.

**We Encourage You to Apply**

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome applicants with relevant experience in education, edtech, consumer brands, nonprofit or mission-driven organizations, corporate, and other environments where they have managed professional social channels, served distinct audiences, and delivered measurable results.

However, this position does require professional responsibility for an organization’s or client’s social presence, hands-on short-form video creation, comfort contributing on camera, and the ability to assess performance against KPIs. If your experience has primarily been creating content for your own personal influencer accounts, without managing an organization’s or client’s channels and results, this role is unlikely to be the right match.

A professional social media portfolio or relevant work samples must be included with your application to be considered. Please share a working link to campaigns, social accounts, video examples, or case studies that demonstrate your direct work and impact. If your work is confidential, you may submit redacted or anonymized case studies and examples that respect client or employer requirements.

If you enjoy creating content yourself, collaborating within a marketing team, using data to make it better, and helping real communities connect with an education brand, we would love to hear from you.

**Please do not submit your application more than once.**

**What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process**

We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next. We do not use AI to review applications; your application is reviewed by a human on the Talent Acquisition team. While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:

1. **Recruiter Conversation:** An introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition about your professional social media background, interests, expectations, and fit for this position

2. **Hiring Manager Conversation:** A deeper conversation with the Senior Director of Marketing, including review of your work, approach to short-form video, audience segmentation, strategy, and results

3. **Team / Cross-Functional Conversation:** A conversation with team members, focused on collaboration and the capabilities relevant to day-to-day success in this role

4. **Final Conversation and Decision:** A final conversation with the team. For finalists, there may be an optional opportunity to connect with additional content teammates. Talent Acquisition will share details and preparation expectations throughout the process.

**Application deadline: Tuesday, October 20th, 2026.**

Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.

**Our Commitment to Inclusion**

Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Sr. Director, Strategic Consulting
description:
**Join a National Top Workplace**

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals who are ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. As a partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are leaders in loyalty, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.

**Join Us from Anywhere**

While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the *freedom to work remotely*. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:

* Flexible Time Off to recharge when needed

* Nine Company-Wide Holidays

* A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being

Discover more about our perks and benefits here.

Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.

**Travel Requirements:**  
As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

### **About the team and what we'll build together**

As the lead Financial Analyst and Strategic Consultant in the Financial Modeling Center of Excellence (COE) at Kobie, you will be the financial architect behind our most ambitious client engagements. You'll transform complex customer and business data into compelling investment cases, scenario models, and commercially grounded program designs that empower clients to make confident, board-level loyalty decisions. Working at the intersection of data science, financial modeling, and loyalty strategy, you'll combine institutional rigor with strategic storytelling, translating quantified insights into clear business narratives that resonate with executive teams.

This is not a back-office finance role. You will be an active participant in client engagements, co-presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders, translating financial insight into strategy, and ensuring every program recommendation is anchored in defensible business value. You'll collaborate closely with Kobie's strategy, analytics, technology, and client services teams, moving fluidly between modeling sprints, client work sessions, and executive presentations. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, and brings both the rigor of institutional analysis and the communication fluency of a senior management consultant. You're a problem-solver who sees financial modeling not as an end, but as the foundation for breakthrough strategy.

### **How you will make an impact**

* Design, Evolve & Optimize Loyalty & Engagement Programs: Serve as a trusted partner to clients, designing, evolving, and optimizing loyalty, retention, or engagement programs (for B2C or B2B) by developing investment business cases that quantify the financial impact of loyalty program design choices, including member tier architecture, reward currency, earn/burn mechanics, and benefit structures that align with clients’ broader business goals.

* Lead and Deliver: Partner with cross-functional Kobie teams to develop and deliver multi-year loyalty program financial models covering revenue lift, member acquisition and retention economics, redemption cost, and program ROI, calibrated to client-specific data. Serve as the financial analytics lead on client engagements, working alongside loyalty strategists, experience designers, and technology architects in cross-functional delivery teams. Provide actionable recommendations and loyalty strategies that align with clients’ business objectives and customer needs.

* Solution & Analyze: Synthesize research and data analysis into insights and recommendations for senior-level clients. Translate financial model outputs into actionable loyalty strategy insights, connecting economics to design choices. Assess and financially model program design and technology migration paths, including cost of switching, and phased implementation scenarios.

* Tell Data Stories: Communicate fact-based, defensible points of view effectively to internal and external stakeholders. Author the Financial Analysis and Business Case sections of client deliverables, including executive summaries suitable for C-suite and board presentation. Present financial models and business case findings directly to senior client audiences, including CFOs, CMOs, and loyalty program executives, with the confidence and clarity of a seasoned consultant.

* Provide Thought Leadership: Monitor and apply relevant market research, industry trends, and best practices. Contribute to the development and refinement of Kobie's proprietary financial modeling frameworks, templates, and business case methodologies for the loyalty consulting practice. Build and maintain a library of loyalty industry financial benchmarks for topics like member lift, redemption economics, program ROI, and CLV data, spanning retail, financial services, travel, and CPG. Publish internal and external POVs, case studies, and frameworks.

* Manage Execution: Oversee scope and deliverables for multiple financial modeling projects and/or clients, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery. Manage client data requests and financial data quality assurance, ensuring models reflect accurate and current business inputs. Proactively identify financial risks, assumptions, gaps, and sensitivities in client engagements and communicate them clearly to project leadership.

### **What you need to be successful**

* Loyalty Program Expertise: Proven experience in the design, implementation, evolution and financial performance of loyalty programs, ensuring they effectively engage customers and drive business results (either B2C or enterprise / B2B) in alignment with the financial business goals and parameters of our clients.

* Cross-Industry / Vertical Perspective: Experience across at least two verticals (e.g. financial services, travel, entertainment, telecom, B2B services) and ability to adapt financial modeling frameworks, KPIs and outputs across sectors.

* Loyalty Marketing Analyst: Deep understanding of the financial modeling and business case requirements and loyalty and/or marketing best practices (rewards earn and redemption, liability management, CRM, digital marketing, CX). Expertise in financial modeling for digital marketing, personalization, omni-channel communication planning, and lifecycle campaign activation.

* Strategic Consulting: Ability to become a trusted advisor to clients through the use of soft skills and thoughtful, strategic recommendations. Skilled in building long-term relationships based on trust and delivering value through consultative approaches.

* Results-Oriented: Efficiently aligns time, budget, and stakeholders to achieve quality outcomes that match organization priorities. Takes personal responsibility through planning and communication.

* Grit: Comfortable working independently on tough assignments. Balances autonomy with the awareness of when to ask for help. Quickly recalibrates after failures to move forward during challenges.

* Influence: Possesses strong presence and gravitas. A data-driven strategy storyteller with the ability to clearly present and influence ideas and concepts. Shares information with a team-first mentality.

* Curiosity: Proactively seeks ways to advance skills. An active listener who provides and receives timely, direct, unbiased, and actionable performance feedback.

* Savvy: Analyzes situations with critical thinking to develop and implement solutions in a high-ambiguity, fast-paced environment. Comfortable navigating grey areas and can simplify complexity.

* Inclusion: Invites diverse perspectives and shares ownership and visibility. Eliminates silos to tackle problems and advance work.

* Bachelor's degree and prior loyalty marketing experience required.

* 10+ years of experience in marketing, loyalty, customer engagement, or consulting.

* Demonstrated experience in loyalty / engagement or CRM consulting (B2C and/or B2B).

* Ideal candidate will have category knowledge in Retail with additional experience in one or more verticals: retail, consumer products, financial services, or travel and hospitality.

* Preferred candidate will have experience with global loyalty programs using programmatic and non-programmatic approaches. Preferences also include candidates with Cobrand, Multi-brand, and/or Paid Program experience.

**Who we are** As a trusted partner, Kobie delivers market-leading, end-to-end loyalty solutions designed to enable customer experiences for the world's most successful brands. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. We believe that our team's passion and expertise are the driving forces behind our success and are proud to be named a Top Workplaces in the USA, where the best and brightest in loyalty drive our mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty.

**A place for all** We celebrate and embrace diversity at Kobie!

Employment at Kobie is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to professional competence. We do not discriminate against any teammate or applicant because of race,color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are fiercely committed to fostering a workplace where teammates can bring their authentic selves to work every day. Our DEI initiatives, including various committees, ensure that principles of equity, diversity, and inclusion are deeply ingrained throughout Kobie. While our leadership team fully supports our policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, it is the responsibility of all teammates to uphold these values.

**Ready to join us?** If you’re ready to make an impact and grow in a supportive, innovative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join the best and brightest in loyalty!
