title: Payer Account Manager
description:
**Payer Account Manager**  
**Location: Remote**

**COMPANY:**

Thea Pharma Inc. is the newly established US commercial organization of French-based pharmaceutical company, Laboratoires Théa (Clermont-Ferrand). Thea Pharma markets a suite of leading eye-care drugs that have been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), including CYKLX™, ZOLYMBUS™, IYUZEH™, Zioptan®, Cosopt®, Cosopt® PF, Azasite®, Akten®, and Betimol®, as well as AcellFX™ Acellular Amniotic Membrane and the portfolio of iVIZIA dry-eye drops and eyelid hygiene products. By focusing its parent company’s passion and expertise within the U.S. market, Thea Pharma’s goal is to deliver uncompromising care that enables all stakeholders to envision the future of ophthalmic treatment with eyes wide open.

**SUMMARY:**

The **Payer Account Manager** is an experienced, field-based member of Thea Pharma’s Payer Strategy team responsible for developing and executing payer account strategies across the U.S. portfolio. This national role will manage an assigned portfolio of priority payer accounts based on business needs, account opportunities, established relationships, and individual expertise. Immediate priorities will include accelerating launch readiness and access for CYKLX and ZOLYMBUS while developing durable payer relationships and capabilities that support all Thea brands and future commercialization opportunities.

The successful candidate will be an established payer account professional who can contribute quickly with limited ramp time, bringing direct relationships with national and regional health plans, PBMs and other key payer decision-makers; demonstrated launch experience, and strong working knowledge of pharmacy and medical benefit access. Experience with Medicare, Medicare Administrative Contractors (MACs), buy-and-bill reimbursement, coding, coverage policy and specialty products is highly valued.

As Thea continues to expand its U.S. market access capabilities, the Payer Account Manager will play an integral role in building an agile, high-performing payer organization. The successful candidate will bring an enterprise mindset, operating with urgency, accountability, sound judgement, and a strong bias for action. This individual must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, navigate ambiguity effectively, and contribute beyond traditional account responsibilities when needed to advance portfolio and organizational priorities. A collaborative, team-first approach and commitment to shared success are essential. This role reports to the Director, Payer Strategy.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Strategic Payer Account Management:** Develop and execute account-specific strategies for an assigned national portfolio of priority payer accounts, including national and regional commercial health plans, MACs, PBMs and other strategically important payer organizations, in alignment with portfolio and brand access objectives.

* **Launch & Access Execution:** Drive payer readiness and account execution for product launches and major access initiatives, with immediate focus on CYKLX and ZOLYMBUS. Anticipate access barriers, establish account-specific action plans and support timely progression from pre-launch engagement through post-launch coverage optimization.

* **Payer Relationship Management:** Leverage and expand established relationships with payer medical directors, pharmacy leaders, formulary and medical-policy stakeholders, contracting partners and other decision-makers to advance productive access discussions.

* **Coverage & Policy Execution:** Assess and address account-level barriers related to formulary placement, medical policy, utilization management, prior authorization, step therapy and other coverage requirements, partnering internally on compliant and evidence-based solutions.

* **Medical & Pharmacy Benefit Expertise:** Apply strong knowledge of pharmacy and medical benefit models, specialty pharmacy, buy-and-bill, ASP reimbursement, J-codes, coding and claims pathways, site-of-care dynamics and provider economics to payer account planning.

* **Medicare & MAC Knowledge:** Apply working knowledge of Medicare Part B and Part D, MAC jurisdictions and coverage processes, and the relationship between coding, reimbursement and policy. Support Medicare/MAC priorities in collaboration with Payer Strategy leadership and other team members.

* **Account Planning & Performance:** Maintain disciplined strategic account plans with clear objectives, stakeholder maps, milestones, risks and next actions. Account ownership and deployment will be aligned to organizational priorities, payer relationships, expertise, and business needs. Document interactions and provide timely visibility into account progress, opportunities and barriers.

* **Payer Intelligence & Insights:** Monitor payer policies, competitive access, benefit design, and emerging market dynamics. Bring actionable field intelligence back to Payer Strategy and cross-functional partners to inform enterprise decisions.

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Parter effectively with Medical Affairs, Marketing, Patient Services, Finance, Legal/Compliance, Sales and other stakeholders to align payer execution with brand and enterprise priorities while maintaining appropriate functional boundaries.

* **Build-the-Business Mindset:** Contribute to development of a growing U.S. payer capability, including account segmentation, launch tools, operating processes, dashboards and field-insight mechanisms. Steps beyond assigned accounts when needed to solve problems and advance team priorities.

* **Team-First Culture:** Operate with urgency, curiosity, humility, and accountability. Share relationships and insights, support colleagues, challenge constructively and prioritize team and enterprise success over individual ownership.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Direct Payer Account Experience:** Demonstrated success directly managing national and/or regional payer accounts within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with responsibility for advancing coverage, policy, formulary or access objectives.

* **Established Payer Relationships:** Current, credible relationships with commercial health plan, PBM and/or other relevant payer decision-makers, with the ability to identify and engage appropriate stakeholders quickly.

* **Launch Experience:** Demonstrated experience supporting at least one pharmaceutical or biologic product launch, including pre-launch payer readiness, early coverage development and post-launch access execution. Multiple launches strongly preferred.

* **Reimbursement & Market Access Knowledge:** Strong understanding of U.S. payer dynamics, pharmacy and medical benefits, specialty products and utilization management. Experience with Medicare/MACs, Part B reimbursement, buy-and-bill, coding and J-code pathways strongly preferred.

* **Strategic Execution:** Ability to translate broader market access strategy into practical account plans, prioritize opportunities and execute independently while escalating issues appropriately.

* **Communicate & Influence:** Strong presentation, negotiation and communication skills, with the judgement and credibility to represent Thea with sophisticated external stakeholders and collaborate effectively with senior internal partners.

* **Entrepreneurial Agility:** Demonstrated success operating in lean, fast-paced or evolving environments. Comfortable creating structure where needed, solving problems proactively and working with incomplete information without sacrificing execution quality.

* **Culture & Collaboration:** High degree of self-awareness, humility and team orientation. Willingness to share expertise, accept feedback, support colleagues and perform work outside narrow role boundaries when business needs require.

* **Compliance:** Strong commitment to applicable healthcare laws, regulations, OIG guidance and company compliance policies.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in business, healthcare, pharmacy, public health or a related discipline preferred.

* **Experience:** 10+ years of progressive pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience preferred, including significant experience in market access, managed markets, payer account management, national accounts or reimbursement. A minimum of 5+ years of direct payer account management experience with meaningful responsibility for external payer relations is strongly preferred.

* **Payer Portfolio:** Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of payer accounts and engaging multiple stakeholder types across complex organizations. National and major regional payer experience strongly preferred.

* **Specialty & Launch Background:** Experience with specialty pharmaceuticals, biologicals, medical-benefit and/or buy-and-bill products strongly preferred. Prior launch experience is required.

* **Therapeutic Experience:** Ophthalmology/retina experience preferred but not required. Proven payer relationships, market access expertise, launch capability and ability to contribute rapidly are prioritized.

* **Systems:** Proficiency with CRM platforms and Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams and Outlook.

* **Travel:** Ability to travel approximately 40-50%, including overnight travel and payer/customer meetings as business needs require.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT**  
This position requires prolonged sitting. Additionally, requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity enough to operate a keyboard, photocopier, telephone, and other office equipment. Requires normal range of hearing and vision to record, prepare, and communicate appropriately. Additional physical requirements include hearing spoken communication clearly.

**BENEFITS AND PERKS**  
Thea offers a full suite of employee benefits, including employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance; a generous schedule of paid time off (PTO); life and disability insurance; paid parental leave; and a competitive 401(k) company match. Thea is a flexible and entrepreneurial work environment where you will enjoy an inclusive culture and the opportunity to have your voice and ideas directly shape the future of the company.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager**

**Kings Media** **Remote | Full-time** **Salary: $3,000–$4,000 USD per month, based on experience and results**

**About Kings Media**

Kings Media is a personal brand agency that works with established founders and businesses. We help clients grow their brands through organic short-form content, content strategy, and marketing systems.

Our team includes content directors, creatives, video editors, and operations specialists. This role will work closely with those teams and have direct communication with company leadership.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Conversion Marketing Manager** to help turn organic content audiences into qualified conversations, booked calls, and customers.

You will be responsible for creating and managing conversion-focused content, lead magnets, DM automations, CRM tracking, and reporting across client accounts.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands both **content and conversion** and can independently manage deadlines and deliverables.

**Responsibilities**

* Create conversion-focused Instagram carousels and Story sequences.
* Write clear, persuasive copy that matches each founder’s voice and brand.
* Develop calls-to-action designed to generate conversations and leads.
* Build and manage ManyChat or similar DM automation flows.
* Set up keyword triggers and DM sequences that move prospects from content into conversations.
* Create and launch lead magnets based on audience needs.
* Connect lead magnets to relevant content and calls-to-action.
* Maintain accurate CRM tracking and lead attribution.
* Manage content calendars, production deadlines, and publishing schedules for assigned clients.
* Track leads, conversations, booked calls, and other relevant performance metrics.
* Prepare weekly performance reports.
* Analyze results and recommend improvements to hooks, offers, CTAs, and conversion processes.
* Work with the content and creative teams to improve performance across client accounts.
* Identify successful strategies and apply them across relevant accounts.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience generating leads through organic content, with measurable results you can share.
* Experience with paid advertising and conversion strategy.
* Strong copywriting skills, particularly for social media carousels and Instagram Stories.
* Hands-on experience with ManyChat or a similar DM automation platform.
* Experience creating lead magnets and connecting them to marketing funnels.
* Experience working with CRM systems and lead tracking.
* Strong understanding of short-form content and why certain content generates engagement and action.
* Experience creating and publishing content yourself.
* Excellent written English, including grammar, spelling, and natural phrasing.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Ability to independently manage deadlines and priorities.
* Ability to analyze performance data and make decisions based on results.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with DM setting or appointment setting.
* Experience qualifying leads through social media conversations.
* Experience booking sales calls through DMs.
* Experience with GoHighLevel.
* Experience with Notion.
* Experience marketing coaches, health professionals, attorneys, or other high-trust service businesses.

**What We Look For**

The ideal candidate:

* Takes ownership of assigned work and follows projects through to completion.
* Can prioritize important tasks and consistently meet deadlines.
* Communicates clearly and promptly with team members.
* Is comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Can identify problems, propose solutions, and take action without constant supervision.
* Uses AI and other tools to improve efficiency while maintaining quality and good judgment.
* Pays close attention to writing quality and accuracy.
* Understands that successful marketing requires both creativity and measurable results.

**Schedule**

* Full-time
* Monday–Friday
* Must be available during **US Mountain Standard Time business hours**
* Remote position
* Candidates may be located outside the United States

**Compensation**

**$3,000–$4,000 USD per month**, depending on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated results.

As Kings Media’s marketing and lead-generation services grow, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities.

**Application Process**

Please include the following with your application:

* **Conversion work** Provide three examples of carousels or Story sequences you have written, along with the results they generated.
* **Organic lead-generation example** Describe one lead-generation system or campaign you built. Include the automation used and the number of leads or booked calls generated.
* **Your own content** Provide a link to content you have personally created and published.
* **2-minute introduction video** Record a short Loom video introducing yourself and walking through one example of your work.
* **Short written response** What is the most recent piece of short-form content that made you take action? What specifically made it effective?

**Selection Process**

Candidates who are shortlisted may be asked to complete a **paid 48-hour practical project** based on a real marketing brief.

The project will involve creating:

* One carousel
* One Story sequence
* A CTA strategy
* An automation plan

Candidates who successfully complete the project will be invited to a final interview with company leadership.

Pay: $3,000.00 - $4,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

**Job Title:** VP, People

The VP, People is a senior People leader responsible for translating business priorities into an effective, consistent, and scalable global People strategy. This role provides leadership across HR business partnership, global associate experience, talent acquisition, organizational effectiveness, performance, and core People programs across multiple business units and jurisdictions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**People Leadership & Functional Oversight**

* Lead and develop key People functions, including HR Business Partnership, Global Experience, and Talent Acquisition, ensuring clear priorities, accountability, and strong execution.
* Build an integrated People operating model that connects business partnership, recruiting, associate experience, performance, and organizational priorities.
* Coach and develop People leaders and team members, strengthening capability and creating clear ownership across the function.
* Establish consistent People practices and service standards across business units and geographies while allowing for appropriate local flexibility.

**HR Business Partnership & Leadership Support**

* Provide strategic guidance to senior leaders on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, team structure, performance, employee relations, and leadership matters.

* Partner with leaders on organizational changes, growth initiatives, integrations, and evolving business needs.
* Use sound judgment to navigate complex and sensitive associate matters in partnership with appropriate internal and external resources.

**Global Associate Experience**

* Oversee the global associate experience strategy, including onboarding, engagement, recognition, communications, culture, and key moments across the associate lifecycle.
* Drive a consistent global experience that reflects company values while recognizing local cultural and jurisdictional differences.
* Use associate feedback, engagement data, and business insights to identify opportunities and improve the employee experience.

**Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Partner with leaders on succession, critical roles, internal mobility, and leadership pipeline needs.
* Support organizational design, role clarity, decision rights, and team effectiveness as the business evolves.
* Identify capability gaps and partner with appropriate resources to address leadership, manager, or organizational development needs.

**Global People Programs & Governance**

* Partner with the EVP, People to execute the global People strategy and annual priorities.
* Ensure People programs, policies, and practices are scalable, consistently applied, and aligned with business needs and local requirements.
* Collaborate with People Operations, Legal, Finance, and business leadership on employment practices, compliance, compensation, benefits, systems, and other cross-functional People matters.
* Support change management and communication for enterprise initiatives, organizational changes, and People programs.

* Establish and monitor meaningful People metrics across recruiting, retention, engagement, performance, workforce trends, and associate experience.
* Translate People data into clear insights, risks, and recommended actions for senior leadership.
* Continuously assess the effectiveness of People programs and team delivery, simplifying or improving processes where needed.

* Demonstrated global HR experience supporting associates and leaders across multiple countries, jurisdictions, or regions.

* Broad HR leadership experience across employee relations, organizational effectiveness, recruiting, associate experience, performance management, workforce planning, and change management.
* Experience operating in complex, multi-entity, high-growth, or evolving organizations.
* Strong business judgment, communication, and executive presence with the ability to balance strategy with hands-on execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience leading People functions in a global, multi-brand, or decentralized organization.
* Experience supporting organizational transformation, integration, or rapid growth.
* Working knowledge of global employment practices and experience partnering with local HR resources or external counsel across jurisdictions.
* Experience using People analytics and HR technology to improve decision-making and operational effectiveness.

  

**Core Competencies**

* Enterprise and business-minded People leadership
* Executive partnership and influence
* Team leadership, coaching, and accountability
* Global mindset and cultural awareness
* Strong judgment and practical problem-solving
* Organizational effectiveness and change leadership
* Data-driven decision-making
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, evolving environments

With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Success in this role goes beyond delivering an accurate forecast. You'll become a trusted strategic finance partner to Playlist's B2B leadership team, bringing a deep understanding of the business and an independent, commercially minded perspective to critical decisions.

You'll strengthen the connection between strategy, revenue performance, go-to-market execution, and financial outcomes. Backed by over a century of printing experience, MCC is focused on the future by developing consumer-driven innovations and sustainable packaging solutions. Working for our team, you can truly make a difference.
  
Position Summary
  
Lead the continued evolution of MCC's Operational Excellence (OpEx) system across the Americas manufacturing network, accelerating performance gains and making sure initiatives deliver measurable business results.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Strategy & Deployment
  

* Lead OpEx strategy across the Americas network.
* Facilitate Hoshin Kanri deployment, translating enterprise priorities into site-level action plans and rolling site results back up into enterprise metrics. Act as the link between plant-level execution and VP/ELT strategy.
* Support S&OP optimization and end-to-end process improvement.

Standard Work & Operating Cadence
  

* Create and enforce a standard lean operating cadence (tiered daily management, gemba routines, leader standard work) so every plant runs the same playbook, not 14 different versions of “lean.”
* Strengthen Managing Daily Improvement (MDI) systems.
* Run a formal certification and capability-maturity model for sites, tied to the OpEx pillars, that creates healthy competition and a clear roadmap for underperforming plants.

Continuous Improvement Execution
  

* Lead Kaizen and Value Stream Mapping activities.
* Own the productivity improvement funnel end to end, from pipeline generation and project prioritization through execution tracking and validated savings, with a standard scorecard reviewed monthly across all 14 sites.
* Partner with Finance to validate savings and productivity gains.
* Lead post-project audits to confirm savings have held at 90 and 180 days.

People & Capability Building
  

* Coach plant leaders in Lean methodologies.
* Build and develop a bench of Site OpEx Managers, with clear capability standards, a coaching cadence, and a succession pipeline, so the network's lean capability doesn't depend on one person.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field
* 10+ years of manufacturing leadership experience
* Multi-site OpEx experience
* Experience building or scaling a standard operating cadence across a multi-site network with varying starting maturity levels
* Demonstrated track record of developing site-level leaders into larger roles
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Hoshin Kanri, Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, MDI, A3, and Root Cause Analysis
* Ability to travel up to 70%
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt (Preferred)
* Packaging or high-volume manufacturing experience (Preferred)
* S&OP experience (Preferred)
* MBA (Preferred)

For over a century, Multi-Color Corporation (MCC) has crafted premium labels for the world’s most iconic and recognizable brands. Our labels elevate emotional connections with consumers and help brands stand out in competitive markets. Honoring our rich history as a market leader, we focus on the future by developing sustainable packaging solutions and consumer-driven innovations.
  
MCC combines global reach with the personalized touch of local service through our network of facilities across 25+ countries. More than 12,000 teammates come together to make our industry-leading work possible and bring our True Colors to life. Join us at MCC, where every product is Labeled with Care. Learn more at www.mcclabel.com.

title: Director of Brand Marketing
description:
**Director of Brand Marketing**

**Location:**
Irvington, NY

**Schedule:**
Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

**Work Model:**
Four days in office, one day remote

**About Electric Picks**

Electric Picks is a rapidly growing jewelry brand known for trend-forward styles, meaningful storytelling, and a lifetime guarantee. We’re entering an exciting new chapter and looking for a Director of Brand Marketing who can help define what the brand becomes next.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of an established brand with significant momentum. You’ll work closely with our Head of Marketing, Founder, and Senior Art Director to translate our vision into campaigns, collaborations, cultural moments, and consumer experiences that grow both brand affinity and the business.

**The Opportunity**

The Director of Brand Marketing, will lead how Electric Picks shows up in the world.

You’ll set the strategic direction while remaining close to the work—from developing campaign concepts and go-to-market plans to building partnerships, creating real-world experiences, and shaping our social presence.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who is looking build the next big lifestyle brand. If you have strong ideas, commercial instincts, and the ability to turn vision into action this role is for you.

**What You’ll Own**

**Shape the Brand**

* Partner with the Head of Marketing and Senior Art Director to define and evolve the Electric Picks brand strategy.
* Translate company priorities into integrated marketing plans that build awareness, attract new customers, and drive revenue.
* Identify opportunities to increase cultural relevance through positioning, storytelling, partnerships, activations, and community.
* Bring consumer insights, cultural trends, and competitive intelligence into the brand’s decision-making.
* Champion bold, thoughtful ideas that deepen the relationship between Electric Picks and its customers.

**Lead Campaigns and Product Launches**

* Develop campaign narratives, messaging frameworks, creative briefs, and go-to-market strategies.
* Own the master marketing calendar, aligning product launches, brand campaigns, collaborations, and channel priorities.
* Partner with the Senior Art Director to bring cohesive campaign ideas to life across every consumer touchpoint.
* Create compelling messaging for launches, core products, and evergreen brand stories.
* Lead integrated campaign planning across eCommerce, Social, CRM, PR, Wholesale, and Paid Media.
* Ensure every campaign has clear objectives, channel roles, timelines, and measures of success.

**Create Cultural Moments**

* Lead experiential events, community activations, influencer trips, OOH, partnerships, and other real-world brand experiences.
* Partner with the Founder to identify and develop talent, brand, and cultural collaborations.
* Build a strategic pipeline of UGC and commissioned content that supports both organic storytelling and paid acquisition.
* Find new ways for Electric Picks to participate in culture and connect meaningfully with its community.

**Lead the Team and the Work**

* Manage, mentor, and develop members of the Brand Marketing and Social teams.
* Shape the brand’s social presence so that every touchpoint reflects a consistent voice, point of view, and personality.
* Serve as the central marketing partner across Creative, Growth, eCommerce, PR, Product, and Wholesale.
* Establish clear priorities, ownership, and expectations across the team.
* Build scalable workflows and planning tools that improve clarity, accountability, and execution.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, curiosity, high standards, and strong follow-through.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 6+ years of brand marketing experience, ideally within fashion, jewelry, beauty, lifestyle, luxury, or another consumer-led category.
* A track record of developing integrated campaigns that increased awareness, created demand, and supported business growth.
* Strong instincts for storytelling, culture, partnerships, events, community, and consumer behavior.
* Experience translating business priorities into cohesive omnichannel marketing plans.
* The ability to move comfortably between strategy, creative development, planning, and hands-on execution.
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience partnering with Creative, Growth, Digital, PR, Product, and Commercial teams.
* Experience managing and developing high-performing team members.
* Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Commercial fluency and the ability to balance creative ambition with budgets, timelines, and measurable results.

**You’ll Thrive Here If You Are**

* A brand builder who is excited by the opportunity to help define the next chapter of a growing company.
* A strategic operator who can see the big picture and translate it into a clear, actionable plan.
* A creative thinker with strong taste, cultural curiosity, and a distinct point of view.
* A hands-on leader who is willing to jump into the work and help move it forward.
* A natural owner who identifies opportunities, solves problems, and creates momentum.
* A clear and thoughtful communicator who brings people together around a shared vision.
* A low-ego, high-EQ collaborator who knows when to lead, support, and execute.
* A mentor who raises the quality of thinking and execution across the team.

**Why Electric Picks**

You’ll join Electric Picks at a pivotal moment, with the opportunity to influence the brand’s long-term vision while making an immediate impact. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, lead high-visibility initiatives, and help build the campaigns, experiences, team, and operating foundation that support our next stage of growth.

title: Director, Digital Media Planning - Contract
description:

**This position is remote within the US.**

Part of this is through addressable media where you know who the person is you are targeting; this includes programmatic video, CTV, programmatic display, email, texting, and some social ads. **Check out www.WeAreMoore.com for more information.**

* Champion innovation by identifying new advertising opportunities, technologies, and media approaches that improve client outcomes.

* Collaborate across teams, agencies, and partners to drive efficient execution and maximize campaign effectiveness.
* Contribute to departmental leadership by supporting workforce planning, team engagement, training initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts.

### **Your Background:**

* 8+ years of experience in digital media planning, buying, and strategy with expertise across programmatic, paid search, and paid social channels.

* Experience managing multiple complex projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional client relationship management and stakeholder communication skills.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-focused with the ability to take initiative and drive projects forward.
* Collaborative leadership style with a customer-service mindset and ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Nonprofit fundraising and marketing experience preferred.

  

**How We’ll Support You:**

* Join the largest marketing and fundraising company in North America serving the nonprofit industry where we prioritize innovation and professional growth.
* Collaborate with industry subject matter experts with over 5,000 employees across the enterprise.
* To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid holidays and generous paid time off so you can have the time and space to recharge pursue your other passions and be with the people you care about.
* Moore is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Director of Production
description:
**Keep Growing with Nutrafol**
------------------------------

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients - and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too - by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation.

Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow.

#### **About you:**

Nutrafol's in-house Creative team makes everything from brand campaigns and product photography to performance ads, social content, and retail assets. As our Director of Production, you'll own how all of that work from a photography, casting and film standpoint gets made: the budgets, expenses. the schedules, the partners, and the shoot days.

This is a senior individual contributor role to start. You won't have direct reports at first. Instead, you'll lead through a network of production companies, agencies, photographers, directors, and freelancers, and through close partnership with our in-house creatives. You'll build the production function from the ground up, set the standards, and help shape how the team grows.

#### **What You'll Do:**

**Own production end to end**

* Lead production for all photo, video, and content shoots across brand, performance marketing, social, e-commerce, and retail.
* Take projects from brief to delivery: scoping, bidding, pre-production, on-set leadership, post-production, and final asset handoff.
* Act as producer on key shoots, and make sure every other shoot has the right producer.

**Manage budgets and partners**

* Build and manage the annual production budget, plus a budget for each project. Track actuals and report on spend to the SVP, Creative.
* Find, vet, and manage a roster of production companies, agencies, directors, photographers, editors, post houses, and freelance crew.
* Run bids, negotiate rates and contracts, and get the most value out of every dollar without lowering the quality of the work.
* Work with Legal and Procurement on SOWs, vendor agreements, and payments.

**Build the operating model**

* Design and run the production calendar across all creative work, balancing what the business needs with the team's capacity.
* Create repeatable workflows, templates, and best practices: production books, call sheets, approval steps, and delivery specs.
* Find ways to make more content more efficiently, such as shoots that serve several channels at once, modular content systems, and in-house studio capabilities.
* Look at and adopt new tools, including AI-assisted production and post-production workflows, where they make the work better or faster.

**Protect the brand and the business**

* Manage talent, model, and influencer usage rights, releases, and renewals. Keep a clear record of where and how long each asset can run.
* Make sure productions follow union rules (SAG-AFTRA and others where they apply), location permits, insurance, and on-set safety.
* Partner with Legal and Regulatory early in the process so that claims, testimonials, and before-and-after content meet our standards for a health and wellness brand.
* Oversee how finished assets are organized, labeled, and stored in our DAM so the whole company can find and use them.

**Partner across the company**

* Work closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Designers, Copywriters, and Brand teams so the work looks the way it was meant to.
* Partner with Growth, Social, E-commerce, Retail, and Product Marketing to understand what assets they need and when.
* Bring production feasibility, cost, and timing into the conversation early, during concept development.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 10+ years of production experience, with at least 3 years at a senior producer, head of production, or director level.
* Experience at an in-house brand team, a creative agency, or a production company. Ideally a mix.
* A track record of producing large-scale photo and video campaigns as well as high-volume content for performance and social channels.
* Strong budget management skills, with experience owning a multimillion-dollar annual production budget.
* A deep network of production partners, crew, and talent, and the judgment to match the right partner to each project.
* Working knowledge of talent contracts, usage rights, union rules, and production insurance.
* Experience setting up production processes and systems where none existed.
* Clear, calm communication with creatives, executives, and vendors, especially when plans change on set.
* Comfort leading through influence. You get things done without direct reports.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in beauty, wellness, CPG, or another regulated category where claims and before-and-after imagery need legal review.
* Experience building or running an in-house studio.
* Familiarity with project management and DAM tools (e.g., Airtable, Asana, Monday, Bynder, Frame.io).
* Experience growing a production team over time.

The listed range is applicable only to the annual base salary and does not include additional perks, benefits, or applicable bonus eligibility comprising the total compensation package.

Salary Range:

title: Cokesbury Kids Director
description:
**JOB SUMMARY**
===============

The **Director of Cokesbury Kids** is the designated team leader for the strategic and daily operations and planning for UMPH-published Cokesbury Kids programs, with accountability for the performance of the business unit team in meeting the needs of markets served by the programs, improving present processes, developing new processes to accomplish the work of the team, and working with other internal units in support of financial goals for Cokesbury Kids. The incumbent supervises and coordinates Cokesbury Kids product planning, theme and content development, manuscript acquisition, editorial development, marketing, and business planning of Cokesbury Kids resources to serve The United Methodist Church and other markets.

**ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT & AREAS OF IMPACT**
============================================

**Reporting Relationship & Peers**
----------------------------------

Reports to the Associate Publisher, as do:

* Associate Editor
* Associate Editor / Project Coordinator
* Cokesbury Kids Team Lead
* Editorial Assistant
* Lead Editor
* Media Editor
* Production & Design Manager(s)
* Production Manager

**Reporting to This Job**
-------------------------

### *EXEMPT*

* Indirect supervision (7)

### *NON-EXEMPT*

* Indirect supervision (1)

### *EXTERNAL*

* Various contractors

**Areas of Impact (as applicable)**
-----------------------------------

### *SALES BUDGET*

* $2.2 M

### *DEPARTMENT OPERATING BUDGET*

* $50,000 (portion of department budget this position administers)

**RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE**
============================

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

### ***PRIMARY***

* Leads the Cokesbury Kids team in developing and implementing an annual publishing, marketing, and promotional plan to assure achievement of financial budgets, targets, and objectives for sales, expenses, cost of goods, inventory levels, and net contribution.
* Directs and guides the editorial stages of production for the 100-plus components of VBS from development through point of delivery of the product to the printer. Writes original content, directs editing of manuscripts, and manages their development through the editorial production process by analyzing structure and content, comparing formats and appeal to competitor products, and appraising and improving readability and format. Leads the editorial team in monitoring the biblical and theological quality and consistency of within Cokesbury Kids resources (with an emphasis on VBS), looking for both compatibility with United Methodist teachings and breadth that allows broader use by other mainline denominations.
* Leads the theme and content development process for VBS and related programs, including customer summits and focus groups, story consultations, and other forms of research.
* Coordinates with the Business Manager, Marketing Manager, Buyer, and editorial staff to create business plans that present product lines designed to meet sales and cost-of-goods targets, optimize inventory, and offer new products that fit audience market interests.

### ***SECONDARY***

* Works with the Marketing Manager to plan and implement competitive promotion and sales campaigns for Cokesbury Kids programs.
* Conducts or supervises product-related workshops and training events as needed.

*These essential job functions are* *not* *intended to cover all work details or the occasional performance of other tasks as assigned by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.*

**Common or Complex Problem-Solving Challenges**
------------------------------------------------

* Achieving the financial objectives for Cokesbury Kids programs in all areas
* Keeping abreast of current trends in Christian education and children’s programming within The United Methodist Church, other constituencies and markets, and secular education markets in order to produce user-friendly resources that sell and are consistent with United Methodist theological and educational standards
* Planning and developing, with the Cokesbury Kids team, dynamic programs and resources to meet or exceed customer expectations and specific UMPH sales and market-penetration goals
* Directing time and available resources to manage more than 100 VBS components through development and production, on time and within budget, while maintaining positive relationships with creators, contract editors and content developers, and internal support units and assuring a high-quality product line
* Working within UMPH-approved policies and business plans to establish schedules, achieve quality standards, and meet sales objectives for the team
* Leading the Cokesbury Kids team in developing general product-line strategies and specific proposals for Cokesbury Kids publishing
* Applying needs and interests of Cokesbury Kids market segments identified through research to product-line development

**Authority & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Authority to collaborate, plan, develop, acquire, and market a range of Cokesbury Kids products to meet editorial, financial, and sales objectives
* Authority to maintain knowledge of customer segments and marketplace trends and to cultivate specific segments in order to increase the customer base
* Authority to develop, implement, and/or review annual strategic plans and individual product-line business plans in consultation with appropriate team members and leaders to support overall UMPH operational objectives
* Accountability for collaborating, developing, and implementing an annual plan to achieve objectives for revenue, expenses, cost of goods, inventory values, inventory turn, net contribution, and other key operational and financial objectives
* Accountability for collaborating with marketing and sales as they develop and implement marketing and promotional plans to achieve financial budgets, targets, and objectives for Cokesbury Kids programs
* Accountability for meeting the editorial, financial, and sales objectives of Cokesbury Kids programs

**Regular Contacts & Stakeholders**
-----------------------------------

### ***INTERNAL***

* Cokesbury Kids team members and other UMPH cross-functional personnel from various units; Business/Buyer team; Marketing team; Sales team; Allied Products team; Digital Production Services; Core Function Managers – provides indirect direction to the Cokesbury Kids leads, media editor, editors, production and design managers, business manager/buyer, and marketing manager

### ***EXTERNAL***

* Contract writers, editors, content developers, and producers; internal and external reviewers/evaluators; United Methodist Curriculum Resources Committee; other external partners and teams as assigned

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**
====================

**Education, Experience, & Certifications**
-------------------------------------------

### ***REQUIRED***

* Bachelor’s degree in business, English, journalism, communications, education, religion, or a related field
* At least five (5) years of experience in publishing, religious education, business management, product development, marketing, or a related field

### ***PREFERRED***

* Master’s degree
* Current or previous participation in Christian education programs within a local congregation

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**
----------------------------------

### ***REQUIRED***

* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of children’s ministry programs and Cokesbury Kids resources.
* Strategic leadership
* Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills and ability to manage a large cross-functional team.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to make presentations and lead workshops.
* Excellent organizational and planning skills.
* Excellent personal computer skills and intermediate proficiency with word-processing and spreadsheet software (Microsoft Word and Excel preferred).
* Ability to travel as needed, with number and duration of trips to be determined.

### ***PREFERRED***

* Working knowledge of media and the incorporation of video, social media, and web-based programs in children’s ministry, marketing, and communication.
* Working knowledge of sales and marketing practices and techniques.

**AI-Enabled Workplace**
------------------------

The United Methodist Publishing House is committed to maximizing the impact of artificial intelligence by adopting and integrating AI tools across our work. These technologies are vital to enhancing productivity, fostering creativity, and strengthening decision-making. All staff members are expected to engage thoughtfully and responsibly with AI as part of their professional responsibilities. Core expectations include:

* **Responsible AI Integration** – Leverage AI tools strategically to streamline workflows, generate actionable insights, and deliver exceptional outcomes that advance our mission.
* **Critical Evaluation & Oversight** – Apply professional judgment and critical thinking when reviewing, refining, and validating all AI-generated content and recommendations to ensure accuracy and alignment with our standards.
* **Continuous Learning & Innovation** – Maintain curiosity and adaptability toward emerging AI technologies, actively contributing to innovative practices within your area of expertise while supporting organizational growth.
* **Ethical & Secure Practice** – Uphold UMPH’s commitment to ethical, transparent, and secure AI usage, ensuring all applications align with our mission, values, and community standards.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

UMPH is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
